      "contentPreview": "---\npaths:\n  - \"**/*.swift\"\n  - \"**/Package.swift\"\n---\n> This file extends common/testing.md with Swift specific content.\nUse **Swift Testing** () for new tests. Use  and :\nEach test gets a fresh instance — set up in , tear down in . No shared mutable state between tests.\nSee skill:  for protocol-ba",
      "rawContent": "---\npaths:\n  - \"**/*.swift\"\n  - \"**/Package.swift\"\n---\n# Swift Testing\n\n> This file extends [common/testing.md](../common/testing.md) with Swift specific content.\n\n## Framework\n\nUse **Swift Testing** (`import Testing`) for new tests. Use `@Test` and `#expect`:\n\n```swift\n@Test(\"User creation validates email\")\nfunc userCreationValidatesEmail() throws {\n    #expect(throws: ValidationError.invalidEmail) {\n        try User(email: \"not-an-email\")\n    }\n}\n```\n\n## Test Isolation\n\nEach test gets a fresh instance — set up in `init`, tear down in `deinit`. No shared mutable state between tests.\n\n## Parameterized Tests\n\n```swift\n@Test(\"Validates formats\", arguments: [\"json\", \"xml\", \"csv\"])\nfunc validatesFormat(format: String) throws {\n    let parser = try Parser(format: format)\n    #expect(parser.isValid)\n}\n```\n\n## Coverage\n\n```bash\nswift test --enable-code-coverage\n```\n\n## Reference\n\nSee skill: `swift-protocol-di-testing` for protocol-based dependency injection and mock patterns with Swift Testing.\n",
      "renderedContent": "<hr>\n<h2>paths:\n  - &quot;<strong>/*.swift&quot;\n  - &quot;<\/strong>/Package.swift&quot;<\/h2>\n<h1>Swift Testing<\/h1>\n<blockquote>\n<p>This file extends <a href=\"../common/testing.md\">common/testing.md<\/a> with Swift specific content.<\/p>\n<\/blockquote>\n<h2>Framework<\/h2>\n<p>Use <strong>Swift Testing<\/strong> (<code>import Testing<\/code>) for new tests. Use <code>@Test<\/code> and <code>#expect<\/code>:<\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-swift\">@Test(&quot;User creation validates email&quot;)\nfunc userCreationValidatesEmail() throws {\n    #expect(throws: ValidationError.invalidEmail) {\n        try User(email: &quot;not-an-email&quot;)\n    }\n}\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h2>Test Isolation<\/h2>\n<p>Each test gets a fresh instance — set up in <code>init<\/code>, tear down in <code>deinit<\/code>. No shared mutable state between tests.<\/p>\n<h2>Parameterized Tests<\/h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-swift\">@Test(&quot;Validates formats&quot;, arguments: [&quot;json&quot;, &quot;xml&quot;, &quot;csv&quot;])\nfunc validatesFormat(format: String) throws {\n    let parser = try Parser(format: format)\n    #expect(parser.isValid)\n}\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h2>Coverage<\/h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">swift test --enable-code-coverage\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h2>Reference<\/h2>\n<p>See skill: <code>swift-protocol-di-testing<\/code> for protocol-based dependency injection and mock patterns with Swift Testing.<\/p>\n"

      "title": "TypeScript/JavaScript Coding Style",
      "description": "--- paths:   - \"**/*.ts\"   - \"**/*.tsx\"   - \"**/*.js\"   - \"**/*.jsx\" --- > This file extends common/coding-style.md with",
      "metadata": {},
      "risks": [],
      "contentPreview": "---\npaths:\n  - \"**/*.ts\"\n  - \"**/*.tsx\"\n  - \"**/*.js\"\n  - \"**/*.jsx\"\n---\n> This file extends common/coding-style.md with TypeScript/JavaScript specific content.\nUse types to make public APIs, shared models, and component props explicit, readable, and reusable.\nAdd parameter and return types to expor",
      "rawContent": "---\npaths:\n  - \"**/*.ts\"\n  - \"**/*.tsx\"\n  - \"**/*.js\"\n  - \"**/*.jsx\"\n---\n# TypeScript/JavaScript Coding Style\n\n> This file extends [common/coding-style.md](../common/coding-style.md) with TypeScript/JavaScript specific content.\n\n## Types and Interfaces\n\nUse types to make public APIs, shared models, and component props explicit, readable, and reusable.\n\n### Public APIs\n\n- Add parameter and return types to exported functions, shared utilities, and public class methods\n- Let TypeScript infer obvious local variable types\n- Extract repeated inline object shapes into named types or interfaces\n\n```typescript\n// WRONG: Exported function without explicit types\nexport function formatUser(user) {\n  return `${user.firstName} ${user.lastName}`\n}\n\n// CORRECT: Explicit types on public APIs\ninterface User {\n  firstName: string\n  lastName: string\n}\n\nexport function formatUser(user: User): string {\n  return `${user.firstName} ${user.lastName}`\n}\n```\n\n### Interfaces vs. Type Aliases\n\n- Use `interface` for object shapes that may be extended or implemented\n- Use `type` for unions, intersections, tuples, mapped types, and utility types\n- Prefer string literal unions over `enum` unless an `enum` is required for interoperability\n\n```typescript\ninterface User {\n  id: string\n  email: string\n}\n\ntype UserRole = 'admin' | 'member'\ntype UserWithRole = User & {\n  role: UserRole\n}\n```\n\n### Avoid `any`\n\n- Avoid `any` in application code\n- Use `unknown` for external or untrusted input, then narrow it safely\n- Use generics when a value's type depends on the caller\n\n```typescript\n// WRONG: any removes type safety\nfunction getErrorMessage(error: any) {\n  return error.message\n}\n\n// CORRECT: unknown forces safe narrowing\nfunction getErrorMessage(error: unknown): string {\n  if (error instanceof Error) {\n    return error.message\n  }\n\n  return 'Unexpected error'\n}\n```\n\n### React Props\n\n- Define component props with a named `interface` or `type`\n- Type callback props explicitly\n- Do not use `React.FC` unless there is a specific reason to do so\n\n```typescript\ninterface User {\n  id: string\n  email: string\n}\n\ninterface UserCardProps {\n  user: User\n  onSelect: (id: string) => void\n}\n\nfunction UserCard({ user, onSelect }: UserCardProps) {\n  return <button onClick={() => onSelect(user.id)}>{user.email}<\/button>\n}\n```\n\n### JavaScript Files\n\n- In `.js` and `.jsx` files, use JSDoc when types improve clarity and a TypeScript migration is not practical\n- Keep JSDoc aligned with runtime behavior\n\n```javascript\n/**\n * @param {{ firstName: string, lastName: string }} user\n * @returns {string}\n */\nexport function formatUser(user) {\n  return `${user.firstName} ${user.lastName}`\n}\n```\n\n## Immutability\n\nUse spread operator for immutable updates:\n\n```typescript\ninterface User {\n  id: string\n  name: string\n}\n\n// WRONG: Mutation\nfunction updateUser(user: User, name: string): User {\n  user.name = name // MUTATION!\n  return user\n}\n\n// CORRECT: Immutability\nfunction updateUser(user: Readonly<User>, name: string): User {\n  return {\n    ...user,\n    name\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## Error Handling\n\nUse async/await with try-catch and narrow unknown errors safely:\n\n```typescript\ninterface User {\n  id: string\n  email: string\n}\n\ndeclare function riskyOperation(userId: string): Promise<User>\n\nfunction getErrorMessage(error: unknown): string {\n  if (error instanceof Error) {\n    return error.message\n  }\n\n  return 'Unexpected error'\n}\n\nconst logger = {\n  error: (message: string, error: unknown) => {\n    // Replace with your production logger (for example, pino or winston).\n  }\n}\n\nasync function loadUser(userId: string): Promise<User> {\n  try {\n    const result = await riskyOperation(userId)\n    return result\n  } catch (error: unknown) {\n    logger.error('Operation failed', error)\n    throw new Error(getErrorMessage(error))\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## Input Validation\n\nUse Zod for schema-based validation and infer types from the schema:\n\n```typescript\nimport { z } from 'zod'\n\nconst userSchema = z.object({\n  email: z.string().email(),\n  age: z.number().int().min(0).max(150)\n})\n\ntype UserInput = z.infer<typeof userSchema>\n\nconst validated: UserInput = userSchema.parse(input)\n```\n\n## Console.log\n\n- No `console.log` statements in production code\n- Use proper logging libraries instead\n- See hooks for automatic detection\n",
      "renderedContent": "<hr>\n<h2>paths:\n  - &quot;<strong>/*.ts&quot;\n  - &quot;<\/strong>/<em>.tsx&quot;\n  - &quot;**/<\/em>.js&quot;\n  - &quot;**/*.jsx&quot;<\/h2>\n<h1>TypeScript/JavaScript Coding Style<\/h1>\n<blockquote>\n<p>This file extends <a href=\"../common/coding-style.md\">common/coding-style.md<\/a> with TypeScript/JavaScript specific content.<\/p>\n<\/blockquote>\n<h2>Types and Interfaces<\/h2>\n<p>Use types to make public APIs, shared models, and component props explicit, readable, and reusable.<\/p>\n<h3>Public APIs<\/h3>\n<ul>\n<li>Add parameter and return types to exported functions, shared utilities, and public class methods<\/li>\n<li>Let TypeScript infer obvious local variable types<\/li>\n<li>Extract repeated inline object shapes into named types or interfaces<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">// WRONG: Exported function without explicit types\nexport function formatUser(user) {\n  return `${user.firstName} ${user.lastName}`\n}\n\n// CORRECT: Explicit types on public APIs\ninterface User {\n  firstName: string\n  lastName: string\n}\n\nexport function formatUser(user: User): string {\n  return `${user.firstName} ${user.lastName}`\n}\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h3>Interfaces vs. Type Aliases<\/h3>\n<ul>\n<li>Use <code>interface<\/code> for object shapes that may be extended or implemented<\/li>\n<li>Use <code>type<\/code> for unions, intersections, tuples, mapped types, and utility types<\/li>\n<li>Prefer string literal unions over <code>enum<\/code> unless an <code>enum<\/code> is required for interoperability<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">interface User {\n  id: string\n  email: string\n}\n\ntype UserRole = &#39;admin&#39; | &#39;member&#39;\ntype UserWithRole = User &amp; {\n  role: UserRole\n}\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h3>Avoid <code>any<\/code><\/h3>\n<ul>\n<li>Avoid <code>any<\/code> in application code<\/li>\n<li>Use <code>unknown<\/code> for external or untrusted input, then narrow it safely<\/li>\n<li>Use generics when a value&#39;s type depends on the caller<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">// WRONG: any removes type safety\nfunction getErrorMessage(error: any) {\n  return error.message\n}\n\n// CORRECT: unknown forces safe narrowing\nfunction getErrorMessage(error: unknown): string {\n  if (error instanceof Error) {\n    return error.message\n  }\n\n  return &#39;Unexpected error&#39;\n}\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h3>React Props<\/h3>\n<ul>\n<li>Define component props with a named <code>interface<\/code> or <code>type<\/code><\/li>\n<li>Type callback props explicitly<\/li>\n<li>Do not use <code>React.FC<\/code> unless there is a specific reason to do so<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">interface User {\n  id: string\n  email: string\n}\n\ninterface UserCardProps {\n  user: User\n  onSelect: (id: string) =&gt; void\n}\n\nfunction UserCard({ user, onSelect }: UserCardProps) {\n  return &lt;button onClick={() =&gt; onSelect(user.id)}&gt;{user.email}&lt;/button&gt;\n}\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h3>JavaScript Files<\/h3>\n<ul>\n<li>In <code>.js<\/code> and <code>.jsx<\/code> files, use JSDoc when types improve clarity and a TypeScript migration is not practical<\/li>\n<li>Keep JSDoc aligned with runtime behavior<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<pre><code class=\"language-javascript\">/**\n * @param {{ firstName: string, lastName: string }} user\n * @returns {string}\n */\nexport function formatUser(user) {\n  return `${user.firstName} ${user.lastName}`\n}\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h2>Immutability<\/h2>\n<p>Use spread operator for immutable updates:<\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">interface User {\n  id: string\n  name: string\n}\n\n// WRONG: Mutation\nfunction updateUser(user: User, name: string): User {\n  user.name = name // MUTATION!\n  return user\n}\n\n// CORRECT: Immutability\nfunction updateUser(user: Readonly&lt;User&gt;, name: string): User {\n  return {\n    ...user,\n    name\n  }\n}\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h2>Error Handling<\/h2>\n<p>Use async/await with try-catch and narrow unknown errors safely:<\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">interface User {\n  id: string\n  email: string\n}\n\ndeclare function riskyOperation(userId: string): Promise&lt;User&gt;\n\nfunction getErrorMessage(error: unknown): string {\n  if (error instanceof Error) {\n    return error.message\n  }\n\n  return &#39;Unexpected error&#39;\n}\n\nconst logger = {\n  error: (message: string, error: unknown) =&gt; {\n    // Replace with your production logger (for example, pino or winston).\n  }\n}\n\nasync function loadUser(userId: string): Promise&lt;User&gt; {\n  try {\n    const result = await riskyOperation(userId)\n    return result\n  } catch (error: unknown) {\n    logger.error(&#39;Operation failed&#39;, error)\n    throw new Error(getErrorMessage(error))\n  }\n}\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h2>Input Validation<\/h2>\n<p>Use Zod for schema-based validation and infer types from the schema:<\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">import { z } from &#39;zod&#39;\n\nconst userSchema = z.object({\n  email: z.string().email(),\n  age: z.number().int().min(0).max(150)\n})\n\ntype UserInput = z.infer&lt;typeof userSchema&gt;\n\nconst validated: UserInput = userSchema.parse(input)\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h2>Console.log<\/h2>\n<ul>\n<li>No <code>console.log<\/code> statements in production code<\/li>\n<li>Use proper logging libraries instead<\/li>\n<li>See hooks for automatic detection<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n"

      "metadata": {},

      "contentPreview": "---\npaths:\n  - \"**/*.ts\"\n  - \"**/*.tsx\"\n  - \"**/*.js\"\n  - \"**/*.jsx\"\n---\n> This file extends common/hooks.md with TypeScript/JavaScript specific content.\nConfigure in :\n**Prettier**: Auto-format JS/TS files after edit\n**TypeScript check**: Run  after editing / files\n**console.log warning**: Warn abo",
      "rawContent": "---\npaths:\n  - \"**/*.ts\"\n  - \"**/*.tsx\"\n  - \"**/*.js\"\n  - \"**/*.jsx\"\n---\n# TypeScript/JavaScript Hooks\n\n> This file extends [common/hooks.md](../common/hooks.md) with TypeScript/JavaScript specific content.\n\n## PostToolUse Hooks\n\nConfigure in `~/.claude/settings.json`:\n\n- **Prettier**: Auto-format JS/TS files after edit\n- **TypeScript check**: Run `tsc` after editing `.ts`/`.tsx` files\n- **console.log warning**: Warn about `console.log` in edited files\n\n## Stop Hooks\n\n- **console.log audit**: Check all modified files for `console.log` before session ends\n",
      "renderedContent": "<hr>\n<h2>paths:\n  - &quot;<strong>/*.ts&quot;\n  - &quot;<\/strong>/<em>.tsx&quot;\n  - &quot;**/<\/em>.js&quot;\n  - &quot;**/*.jsx&quot;<\/h2>\n<h1>TypeScript/JavaScript Hooks<\/h1>\n<blockquote>\n<p>This file extends <a href=\"../common/hooks.md\">common/hooks.md<\/a> with TypeScript/JavaScript specific content.<\/p>\n<\/blockquote>\n<h2>PostToolUse Hooks<\/h2>\n<p>Configure in <code>~/.claude/settings.json<\/code>:<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Prettier<\/strong>: Auto-format JS/TS files after edit<\/li>\n<li><strong>TypeScript check<\/strong>: Run <code>tsc<\/code> after editing <code>.ts<\/code>/<code>.tsx<\/code> files<\/li>\n<li><strong>console.log warning<\/strong>: Warn about <code>console.log<\/code> in edited files<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>Stop Hooks<\/h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>console.log audit<\/strong>: Check all modified files for <code>console.log<\/code> before session ends<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n"
    },

      "contentPreview": "---\npaths:\n  - \"**/*.ts\"\n  - \"**/*.tsx\"\n  - \"**/*.js\"\n  - \"**/*.jsx\"\n---\n> This file extends common/patterns.md with TypeScript/JavaScript specific content.",
      "rawContent": "---\npaths:\n  - \"**/*.ts\"\n  - \"**/*.tsx\"\n  - \"**/*.js\"\n  - \"**/*.jsx\"\n---\n# TypeScript/JavaScript Patterns\n\n> This file extends [common/patterns.md](../common/patterns.md) with TypeScript/JavaScript specific content.\n\n## API Response Format\n\n```typescript\ninterface ApiResponse<T> {\n  success: boolean\n  data?: T\n  error?: string\n  meta?: {\n    total: number\n    page: number\n    limit: number\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## Custom Hooks Pattern\n\n```typescript\nexport function useDebounce<T>(value: T, delay: number): T {\n  const [debouncedValue, setDebouncedValue] = useState<T>(value)\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const handler = setTimeout(() => setDebouncedValue(value), delay)\n    return () => clearTimeout(handler)\n  }, [value, delay])\n\n  return debouncedValue\n}\n```\n\n## Repository Pattern\n\n```typescript\ninterface Repository<T> {\n  findAll(filters?: Filters): Promise<T[]>\n  findById(id: string): Promise<T | null>\n  create(data: CreateDto): Promise<T>\n  update(id: string, data: UpdateDto): Promise<T>\n  delete(id: string): Promise<void>\n}\n```\n",
      "renderedContent": "<hr>\n<h2>paths:\n  - &quot;<strong>/*.ts&quot;\n  - &quot;<\/strong>/<em>.tsx&quot;\n  - &quot;**/<\/em>.js&quot;\n  - &quot;**/*.jsx&quot;<\/h2>\n<h1>TypeScript/JavaScript Patterns<\/h1>\n<blockquote>\n<p>This file extends <a href=\"../common/patterns.md\">common/patterns.md<\/a> with TypeScript/JavaScript specific content.<\/p>\n<\/blockquote>\n<h2>API Response Format<\/h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">interface ApiResponse&lt;T&gt; {\n  success: boolean\n  data?: T\n  error?: string\n  meta?: {\n    total: number\n    page: number\n    limit: number\n  }\n}\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h2>Custom Hooks Pattern<\/h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">export function useDebounce&lt;T&gt;(value: T, delay: number): T {\n  const [debouncedValue, setDebouncedValue] = useState&lt;T&gt;(value)\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const handler = setTimeout(() =&gt; setDebouncedValue(value), delay)\n    return () =&gt; clearTimeout(handler)\n  }, [value, delay])\n\n  return debouncedValue\n}\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h2>Repository Pattern<\/h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">interface Repository&lt;T&gt; {\n  findAll(filters?: Filters): Promise&lt;T[]&gt;\n  findById(id: string): Promise&lt;T | null&gt;\n  create(data: CreateDto): Promise&lt;T&gt;\n  update(id: string, data: UpdateDto): Promise&lt;T&gt;\n  delete(id: string): Promise&lt;void&gt;\n}\n<\/code><\/pre>\n"
    },

      "rawContent": "---\npaths:\n  - \"**/*.ts\"\n  - \"**/*.tsx\"\n  - \"**/*.js\"\n  - \"**/*.jsx\"\n---\n# TypeScript/JavaScript Security\n\n> This file extends [common/security.md](../common/security.md) with TypeScript/JavaScript specific content.\n\n## Secret Management\n\n```typescript\n// NEVER: Hardcoded secrets\nconst apiKey = \"sk-proj-xxxxx\"\n\n// ALWAYS: Environment variables\nconst apiKey = process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY\n\nif (!apiKey) {\n  throw new Error('OPENAI_API_KEY not configured')\n}\n```\n\n## Agent Support\n\n- Use **security-reviewer** skill for comprehensive security audits\n",

      "contentPreview": "> This file extends common/coding-style.md with web-specific frontend content.\nOrganize by feature or surface area, not by file type:\nDefine design tokens as variables. Do not hardcode palette, typography, or spacing repeatedly:\nPrefer compositor-friendly motion:\n(sparingly)\nAvoid animating layout-b",
      "rawContent": "> This file extends [common/coding-style.md](../common/coding-style.md) with web-specific frontend content.\n\n# Web Coding Style\n\n## File Organization\n\nOrganize by feature or surface area, not by file type:\n\n```text\nsrc/\n├── components/\n│   ├── hero/\n│   │   ├── Hero.tsx\n│   │   ├── HeroVisual.tsx\n│   │   └── hero.css\n│   ├── scrolly-section/\n│   │   ├── ScrollySection.tsx\n│   │   ├── StickyVisual.tsx\n│   │   └── scrolly.css\n│   └── ui/\n│       ├── Button.tsx\n│       ├── SurfaceCard.tsx\n│       └── AnimatedText.tsx\n├── hooks/\n│   ├── useReducedMotion.ts\n│   └── useScrollProgress.ts\n├── lib/\n│   ├── animation.ts\n│   └── color.ts\n└── styles/\n    ├── tokens.css\n    ├── typography.css\n    └── global.css\n```\n\n## CSS Custom Properties\n\nDefine design tokens as variables. Do not hardcode palette, typography, or spacing repeatedly:\n\n```css\n:root {\n  --color-surface: oklch(98% 0 0);\n  --color-text: oklch(18% 0 0);\n  --color-accent: oklch(68% 0.21 250);\n\n  --text-base: clamp(1rem, 0.92rem + 0.4vw, 1.125rem);\n  --text-hero: clamp(3rem, 1rem + 7vw, 8rem);\n\n  --space-section: clamp(4rem, 3rem + 5vw, 10rem);\n\n  --duration-fast: 150ms;\n  --duration-normal: 300ms;\n  --ease-out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);\n}\n```\n\n## Animation-Only Properties\n\nPrefer compositor-friendly motion:\n- `transform`\n- `opacity`\n- `clip-path`\n- `filter` (sparingly)\n\nAvoid animating layout-bound properties:\n- `width`\n- `height`\n- `top`\n- `left`\n- `margin`\n- `padding`\n- `border`\n- `font-size`\n\n## Semantic HTML First\n\n```html\n<header>\n  <nav aria-label=\"Main navigation\">...<\/nav>\n<\/header>\n<main>\n  <section aria-labelledby=\"hero-heading\">\n    <h1 id=\"hero-heading\">...<\/h1>\n  <\/section>\n<\/main>\n<footer>...<\/footer>\n```\n\nDo not reach for generic wrapper `div` stacks when a semantic element exists.\n\n## Naming\n\n- Components: PascalCase (`ScrollySection`, `SurfaceCard`)\n- Hooks: `use` prefix (`useReducedMotion`)\n- CSS classes: kebab-case or utility classes\n- Animation timelines: camelCase with intent (`heroRevealTl`)\n",
      "renderedContent": "<blockquote>\n<p>This file extends <a href=\"../common/coding-style.md\">common/coding-style.md<\/a> with web-specific frontend content.<\/p>\n<\/blockquote>\n<h1>Web Coding Style<\/h1>\n<h2>File Organization<\/h2>\n<p>Organize by feature or surface area, not by file type:<\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-text\">src/\n├── components/\n│   ├── hero/\n│   │   ├── Hero.tsx\n│   │   ├── HeroVisual.tsx\n│   │   └── hero.css\n│   ├── scrolly-section/\n│   │   ├── ScrollySection.tsx\n│   │   ├── StickyVisual.tsx\n│   │   └── scrolly.css\n│   └── ui/\n│       ├── Button.tsx\n│       ├── SurfaceCard.tsx\n│       └── AnimatedText.tsx\n├── hooks/\n│   ├── useReducedMotion.ts\n│   └── useScrollProgress.ts\n├── lib/\n│   ├── animation.ts\n│   └── color.ts\n└── styles/\n    ├── tokens.css\n    ├── typography.css\n    └── global.css\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h2>CSS Custom Properties<\/h2>\n<p>Define design tokens as variables. Do not hardcode palette, typography, or spacing repeatedly:<\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-css\">:root {\n  --color-surface: oklch(98% 0 0);\n  --color-text: oklch(18% 0 0);\n  --color-accent: oklch(68% 0.21 250);\n\n  --text-base: clamp(1rem, 0.92rem + 0.4vw, 1.125rem);\n  --text-hero: clamp(3rem, 1rem + 7vw, 8rem);\n\n  --space-section: clamp(4rem, 3rem + 5vw, 10rem);\n\n  --duration-fast: 150ms;\n  --duration-normal: 300ms;\n  --ease-out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);\n}\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h2>Animation-Only Properties<\/h2>\n<p>Prefer compositor-friendly motion:<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>transform<\/code><\/li>\n<li><code>opacity<\/code><\/li>\n<li><code>clip-path<\/code><\/li>\n<li><code>filter<\/code> (sparingly)<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<p>Avoid animating layout-bound properties:<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>width<\/code><\/li>\n<li><code>height<\/code><\/li>\n<li><code>top<\/code><\/li>\n<li><code>left<\/code><\/li>\n<li><code>margin<\/code><\/li>\n<li><code>padding<\/code><\/li>\n<li><code>border<\/code><\/li>\n<li><code>font-size<\/code><\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>Semantic HTML First<\/h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-html\">&lt;header&gt;\n  &lt;nav aria-label=&quot;Main navigation&quot;&gt;...&lt;/nav&gt;\n&lt;/header&gt;\n&lt;main&gt;\n  &lt;section aria-labelledby=&quot;hero-heading&quot;&gt;\n    &lt;h1 id=&quot;hero-heading&quot;&gt;...&lt;/h1&gt;\n  &lt;/section&gt;\n&lt;/main&gt;\n&lt;footer&gt;...&lt;/footer&gt;\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<p>Do not reach for generic wrapper <code>div<\/code> stacks when a semantic element exists.<\/p>\n<h2>Naming<\/h2>\n<ul>\n<li>Components: PascalCase (<code>ScrollySection<\/code>, <code>SurfaceCard<\/code>)<\/li>\n<li>Hooks: <code>use<\/code> prefix (<code>useReducedMotion<\/code>)<\/li>\n<li>CSS classes: kebab-case or utility classes<\/li>\n<li>Animation timelines: camelCase with intent (<code>heroRevealTl<\/code>)<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n"

      "path": "rules/web/design-quality.md",
      "title": "Web Design Quality Standards",
      "description": "> This file extends common/patterns.md with web-specific design-quality guidance. Do not ship generic template-looking U",
      "metadata": {},
      "risks": [],
      "contentPreview": "> This file extends common/patterns.md with web-specific design-quality guidance.\nDo not ship generic template-looking UI. Frontend output should look intentional, opinionated, and specific to the product.\nDefault card grids with uniform spacing and no hierarchy\nStock hero section with centered head",
      "rawContent": "> This file extends [common/patterns.md](../common/patterns.md) with web-specific design-quality guidance.\n\n# Web Design Quality Standards\n\n## Anti-Template Policy\n\nDo not ship generic template-looking UI. Frontend output should look intentional, opinionated, and specific to the product.\n\n### Banned Patterns\n\n- Default card grids with uniform spacing and no hierarchy\n- Stock hero section with centered headline, gradient blob, and generic CTA\n- Unmodified library defaults passed off as finished design\n- Flat layouts with no layering, depth, or motion\n- Uniform radius, spacing, and shadows across every component\n- Safe gray-on-white styling with one decorative accent color\n- Dashboard-by-numbers layouts with sidebar + cards + charts and no point of view\n- Default font stacks used without a deliberate reason\n\n### Required Qualities\n\nEvery meaningful frontend surface should demonstrate at least four of these:\n\n1. Clear hierarchy through scale contrast\n2. Intentional rhythm in spacing, not uniform padding everywhere\n3. Depth or layering through overlap, shadows, surfaces, or motion\n4. Typography with character and a real pairing strategy\n5. Color used semantically, not just decoratively\n6. Hover, focus, and active states that feel designed\n7. Grid-breaking editorial or bento composition where appropriate\n8. Texture, grain, or atmosphere when it fits the visual direction\n9. Motion that clarifies flow instead of distracting from it\n10. Data visualization treated as part of the design system, not an afterthought\n\n## Before Writing Frontend Code\n\n1. Pick a specific style direction. Avoid vague defaults like \"clean minimal\".\n2. Define a palette intentionally.\n3. Choose typography deliberately.\n4. Gather at least a small set of real references.\n5. Use ECC design/frontend skills where relevant.\n\n## Worthwhile Style Directions\n\n- Editorial / magazine\n- Neo-brutalism\n- Glassmorphism with real depth\n- Dark luxury or light luxury with disciplined contrast\n- Bento layouts\n- Scrollytelling\n- 3D integration\n- Swiss / International\n- Retro-futurism\n\nDo not default to dark mode automatically. Choose the visual direction the product actually wants.\n\n## Component Checklist\n\n- [ ] Does it avoid looking like a default Tailwind or shadcn template?\n- [ ] Does it have intentional hover/focus/active states?\n- [ ] Does it use hierarchy rather than uniform emphasis?\n- [ ] Would this look believable in a real product screenshot?\n- [ ] If it supports both themes, do both light and dark feel intentional?\n",

Avoid vague defaults like &quot;clean minimal&quot;.<\/li>\n<li>Define a palette intentionally.<\/li>\n<li>Choose typography deliberately.<\/li>\n<li>Gather at least a small set of real references.<\/li>\n<li>Use ECC design/frontend skills where relevant.<\/li>\n<\/ol>\n<h2>Worthwhile Style Directions<\/h2>\n<ul>\n<li>Editorial / magazine<\/li>\n<li>Neo-brutalism<\/li>\n<li>Glassmorphism with real depth<\/li>\n<li>Dark luxury or light luxury with disciplined contrast<\/li>\n<li>Bento layouts<\/li>\n<li>Scrollytelling<\/li>\n<li>3D integration<\/li>\n<li>Swiss / International<\/li>\n<li>Retro-futurism<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<p>Do not default to dark mode automatically. Choose the visual direction the product actually wants.<\/p>\n<h2>Component Checklist<\/h2>\n<ul>\n<li><input disabled=\"\" type=\"checkbox\"> Does it avoid looking like a default Tailwind or shadcn template?<\/li>\n<li><input disabled=\"\" type=\"checkbox\"> Does it have intentional hover/focus/active states?<\/li>\n<li><input disabled=\"\" type=\"checkbox\"> Does it use hierarchy rather than uniform emphasis?<\/li>\n<li><input disabled=\"\" type=\"checkbox\"> Would this look believable in a real product screenshot?<\/li>\n<li><input disabled=\"\" type=\"checkbox\"> If it supports both themes, do both light and dark feel intentional?<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n"

      "contentPreview": "> This file extends common/hooks.md with web-specific hook recommendations.\nPrefer project-local tooling. Do not wire hooks to remote one-off package execution.\nUse the project's existing formatter entrypoint after edits:\nEquivalent local commands via  or  are fine when they use repo-owned dependenc",
      "rawContent": "> This file extends [common/hooks.md](../common/hooks.md) with web-specific hook recommendations.\n\n# Web Hooks\n\n## Recommended PostToolUse Hooks\n\nPrefer project-local tooling. Do not wire hooks to remote one-off package execution.\n\n### Format on Save\n\nUse the project's existing formatter entrypoint after edits:\n\n```json\n{\n  \"hooks\": {\n    \"PostToolUse\": [\n      {\n        \"matcher\": \"Write|Edit\",\n        \"command\": \"pnpm prettier --write \\\"$FILE_PATH\\\"\",\n        \"description\": \"Format edited frontend files\"\n      }\n    ]\n  }\n}\n```\n\nEquivalent local commands via `yarn prettier` or `npm exec prettier --` are fine when they use repo-owned dependencies.\n\n### Lint Check\n\n```json\n{\n  \"hooks\": {\n    \"PostToolUse\": [\n      {\n        \"matcher\": \"Write|Edit\",\n        \"command\": \"pnpm eslint --fix \\\"$FILE_PATH\\\"\",\n        \"description\": \"Run ESLint on edited frontend files\"\n      }\n    ]\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### Type Check\n\n```json\n{\n  \"hooks\": {\n    \"PostToolUse\": [\n      {\n        \"matcher\": \"Write|Edit\",\n        \"command\": \"pnpm tsc --noEmit --pretty false\",\n        \"description\": \"Type-check after frontend edits\"\n      }\n    ]\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### CSS Lint\n\n```json\n{\n  \"hooks\": {\n    \"PostToolUse\": [\n      {\n        \"matcher\": \"Write|Edit\",\n        \"command\": \"pnpm stylelint --fix \\\"$FILE_PATH\\\"\",\n        \"description\": \"Lint edited stylesheets\"\n      }\n    ]\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## PreToolUse Hooks\n\n### Guard File Size\n\nBlock oversized writes from tool input content, not from a file that may not exist yet:\n\n```json\n{\n  \"hooks\": {\n    \"PreToolUse\": [\n      {\n        \"matcher\": \"Write\",\n        \"command\": \"node -e \\\"let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{const i=JSON.parse(d);const c=i.tool_input?.content||'';const lines=c.split('\\\\n').length;if(lines>800){console.error('[Hook] BLOCKED: File exceeds 800 lines ('+lines+' lines)');console.error('[Hook] Split into smaller modules');process.exit(2)}console.log(d)})\\\"\",\n        \"description\": \"Block writes that exceed 800 lines\"\n      }\n    ]\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## Stop Hooks\n\n### Final Build Verification\n\n```json\n{\n  \"hooks\": {\n    \"Stop\": [\n      {\n        \"command\": \"pnpm build\",\n        \"description\": \"Verify the production build at session end\"\n      }\n    ]\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## Ordering\n\nRecommended order:\n1. format\n2. lint\n3. type check\n4. build verification\n",

Do not wire hooks to remote one-off package execution.<\/p>\n<h3>Format on Save<\/h3>\n<p>Use the project&#39;s existing formatter entrypoint after edits:<\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;hooks&quot;: {\n    &quot;PostToolUse&quot;: [\n      {\n        &quot;matcher&quot;: &quot;Write|Edit&quot;,\n        &quot;command&quot;: &quot;pnpm prettier --write \\&quot;$FILE_PATH\\&quot;&quot;,\n        &quot;description&quot;: &quot;Format edited frontend files&quot;\n      }\n    ]\n  }\n}\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<p>Equivalent local commands via <code>yarn prettier<\/code> or <code>npm exec prettier --<\/code> are fine when they use repo-owned dependencies.<\/p>\n<h3>Lint Check<\/h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;hooks&quot;: {\n    &quot;PostToolUse&quot;: [\n      {\n        &quot;matcher&quot;: &quot;Write|Edit&quot;,\n        &quot;command&quot;: &quot;pnpm eslint --fix \\&quot;$FILE_PATH\\&quot;&quot;,\n        &quot;description&quot;: &quot;Run ESLint on edited frontend files&quot;\n      }\n    ]\n  }\n}\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h3>Type Check<\/h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;hooks&quot;: {\n    &quot;PostToolUse&quot;: [\n      {\n        &quot;matcher&quot;: &quot;Write|Edit&quot;,\n        &quot;command&quot;: &quot;pnpm tsc --noEmit --pretty false&quot;,\n        &quot;description&quot;: &quot;Type-check after frontend edits&quot;\n      }\n    ]\n  }\n}\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h3>CSS Lint<\/h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;hooks&quot;: {\n    &quot;PostToolUse&quot;: [\n      {\n        &quot;matcher&quot;: &quot;Write|Edit&quot;,\n        &quot;command&quot;: &quot;pnpm stylelint --fix \\&quot;$FILE_PATH\\&quot;&quot;,\n        &quot;description&quot;: &quot;Lint edited stylesheets&quot;\n      }\n    ]\n  }\n}\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h2>PreToolUse Hooks<\/h2>\n<h3>Guard File Size<\/h3>\n<p>Block oversized writes from tool input content, not from a file that may not exist yet:<\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;hooks&quot;: {\n    &quot;PreToolUse&quot;: [\n      {\n        &quot;matcher&quot;: &quot;Write&quot;,\n        &quot;command&quot;: &quot;node -e \\&quot;let d=&#39;&#39;;process.stdin.on(&#39;data&#39;,c=&gt;d+=c);process.stdin.on(&#39;end&#39;,()=&gt;{const i=JSON.parse(d);const c=i.tool_input?.content||&#39;&#39;;const lines=c.split(&#39;\\\\n&#39;).length;if(lines&gt;800){console.error(&#39;[Hook] BLOCKED: File exceeds 800 lines (&#39;+lines+&#39; lines)&#39;);console.error(&#39;[Hook] Split into smaller modules&#39;);process.exit(2)}console.log(d)})\\&quot;&quot;,\n        &quot;description&quot;: &quot;Block writes that exceed 800 lines&quot;\n      }\n    ]\n  }\n}\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h2>Stop Hooks<\/h2>\n<h3>Final Build Verification<\/h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;hooks&quot;: {\n    &quot;Stop&quot;: [\n      {\n        &quot;command&quot;: &quot;pnpm build&quot;,\n        &quot;description&quot;: &quot;Verify the production build at session end&quot;\n      }\n    ]\n  }\n}\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h2>Ordering<\/h2>\n<p>Recommended order:<\/p>\n<ol>\n<li>format<\/li>\n<li>lint<\/li>\n<li>type check<\/li>\n<li>build verification<\/li>\n<\/ol>\n"

      "rawContent": "> This file extends [common/patterns.md](../common/patterns.md) with web-specific patterns.\n\n# Web Patterns\n\n## Component Composition\n\n### Compound Components\n\nUse compound components when related UI shares state and interaction semantics:\n\n```tsx\n<Tabs defaultValue=\"overview\">\n  <Tabs.List>\n    <Tabs.Trigger value=\"overview\">Overview<\/Tabs.Trigger>\n value=\"settings\">...<\/Tabs.Content>\n<\/Tabs>\n```\n\n- Parent owns state\n- Children consume via context\n- Prefer this over prop drilling for complex widgets\n\n### Render Props / Slots\n\n- Use render props or slot patterns when behavior is shared but markup must vary\n- Keep keyboard handling, ARIA, and focus logic in the headless layer\n\n### Container / Presentational Split\n\n- Container components own data loading and side effects\n- Presentational components receive props and render UI\n- Presentational components should stay pure\n\n## State Management\n\nTreat these separately:\n\n| Concern | Tooling |\n|---------|---------|\n| Server state | TanStack Query, SWR, tRPC |\n| Client state | Zustand, Jotai, signals |\n| URL state | search params, route segments |\n| state in the URL:\n- filters\n- sort order\n- pagination\n- active tab\n- search query\n\n## Data Fetching\n\n### Stale-While-Revalidate\n\n- Return cached data immediately\n- Revalidate in the background\n- Prefer existing libraries instead of rolling this by hand\n\n### Optimistic Updates\n\n- Snapshot current state\n- Apply optimistic update\n- Roll back on failure\n- Emit visible error       "metadata": {},
      "risks": [],
      "contentPreview": "> This file extends common/performance.md with web-specific performance content.\n| Metric | Target |\n|--------|--------|\n| LCP | < 2.5s |\n| INP | < 200ms |\n| CLS | < 0.1 |\n| FCP | < 1.5s |\n| TBT | < 200ms |\n| Page Type | JS Budget (gzipped) | CSS Budget |\n|-----------|---------------------|---------",
      "rawContent": "> This file extends [common/performance.md](../common/performance.md) with web-specific performance content.\n\n# Web Performance Rules\n\n## Core Web Vitals Targets\n\n| Metric | Target |\n|--------|--------|\n| LCP | < 2.5s |\n| INP | < 200ms |\n| CLS | < 0.1 |\n| FCP | < 1.5s |\n| TBT | < 200ms |\n\n## Bundle Budget\n\n| Page Type | JS Budget (gzipped) | CSS Budget |\n|-----------|---------------------|------------|\n| Landing page | < 150kb | < 30kb |\n| App page | < 300kb | < 50kb |\n| Microsite | < 80kb | < 15kb |\n\n## Loading Strategy\n\n1. Inline critical above-the-fold CSS where justified\n2. Preload the hero image and primary font only\n3. Defer non-critical CSS or JS\n4. Dynamically import heavy libraries\n\n```js\nconst gsapModule = await import('gsap');\nconst { ScrollTrigger } = await import('gsap/ScrollTrigger');\n```\n\n## Image Optimization\n\n- Explicit `width` and `height`\n- `loading=\"eager\"` plus `fetchpriority=\"high\"` for hero media only\n- `loading=\"lazy\"` for below-the-fold assets\n- Prefer AVIF or WebP with fallbacks\n- Never ship source images far beyond rendered size\n\n## Font Loading\n\n- Max two font families unless there is a clear exception\n- `font-display: swap`\n- Subset where possible\n- Preload only the truly critical weight/style\n\n## Animation Performance\n\n- Animate compositor-friendly properties only\n- Use `will-change` narrowly and remove it when done\n- Prefer CSS for simple transitions\n- Use `requestAnimationFrame` or established animation libraries for JS motion\n- Avoid scroll handler churn; use IntersectionObserver or well-behaved libraries\n\n## Performance Checklist\n\n- [ ] All images have explicit dimensions\n- [ ] No accidental render-blocking resources\n- [ ] No layout shifts from dynamic content\n- [ ] Motion stays on compositor-friendly properties\n- [ ] Third-party scripts load async/defer and only when needed\n",
      "renderedContent": "<blockquote>\n<p>This file extends <a href=\"../common/performance.md\">common/performance.md<\/a> with web-specific performance content.<\/p>\n<\/blockquote>\n<h1>Web Performance Rules<\/h1>\n<h2>Core Web Vitals Targets<\/h2>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Metric<\/th>\n<th>Target<\/th>\n<\/tr>\n<\/thead>\n<tbody><tr>\n<td>LCP<\/td>\n<td>&lt; 2.5s<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<tr>\n<td>INP<\/td>\n<td>&lt; 200ms<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<tr>\n<td>CLS<\/td>\n<td>&lt; 0.1<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<tr>\n<td>FCP<\/td>\n<td>&lt; 1.5s<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<tr>\n<td>TBT<\/td>\n<td>&lt; 200ms<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<\/tbody><\/table>\n<h2>Bundle Budget<\/h2>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Page Type<\/th>\n<th>JS Budget (gzipped)<\/th>\n<th>CSS Budget<\/th>\n<\/tr>\n<\/thead>\n<tbody><tr>\n<td>Landing page<\/td>\n<td>&lt; 150kb<\/td>\n<td>&lt; 30kb<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<tr>\n<td>App page<\/td>\n<td>&lt; 300kb<\/td>\n<td>&lt; 50kb<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<tr>\n<td>Microsite<\/td>\n<td>&lt; 80kb<\/td>\n<td>&lt; 15kb<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<\/tbody><\/table>\n<h2>Loading Strategy<\/h2>\n<ol>\n<li>Inline critical above-the-fold CSS where justified<\/li>\n<li>Preload the hero image and primary font only<\/li>\n<li>Defer non-critical CSS or JS<\/li>\n<li>Dynamically import heavy libraries<\/li>\n<\/ol>\n<pre><code class=\"language-js\">const gsapModule = await import(&#39;gsap&#39;);\nconst { ScrollTrigger } = await import(&#39;gsap/ScrollTrigger&#39;);\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h2>Image Optimization<\/h2>\n<ul>\n<li>Explicit <code>width<\/code> and <code>height<\/code><\/li>\n<li><code>loading=&quot;eager&quot;<\/code> plus <code>fetchpriority=&quot;high&quot;<\/code> for hero media only<\/li>\n<li><code>loading=&quot;lazy&quot;<\/code> for below-the-fold assets<\/li>\n<li>Prefer AVIF or WebP with fallbacks<\/li>\n<li>Never ship source images far beyond rendered size<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>Font Loading<\/h2>\n<ul>\n<li>Max two font families unless there is a clear exception<\/li>\n<li><code>font-display: swap<\/code><\/li>\n<li>Subset where possible<\/li>\n<li>Preload only the truly critical weight/style<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>Animation Performance<\/h2>\n<ul>\n<li>Animate compositor-friendly properties only<\/li>\n<li>Use <code>will-change<\/code> narrowly and remove it when done<\/li>\n<li>Prefer CSS for simple transitions<\/li>\n<li>Use <code>requestAnimationFrame<\/code> or established animation libraries for JS motion<\/li>\n<li>Avoid scroll handler churn;       "title": "Web Security Rules",
      "description": "> This file extends common/security.md with web-specific security content. Always configure a production CSP. Use a per-",
      "metadata": {},
      "risks": [],
      "contentPreview": "> This file extends common/security.md with web-specific security content.\nAlways configure a production CSP.\nUse a per-request nonce for scripts instead of .\nAdjust origins to the project. Do not cargo-cult this block unchanged.\nNever inject unsanitized HTML\nAvoid  /  unless sanitized first\nEscape ",
      "rawContent": "> This file extends [common/security.md](../common/security.md) with web-specific security content.\n\n# Web Security Rules\n\n## Content Security Policy\n\nAlways configure a production CSP.\n\n### Nonce-Based CSP\n\nUse a per-request nonce for scripts instead of `'unsafe-inline'`.\n\n```text\nContent-Security-Policy:\n  default-src 'self';\n  script-src 'self' 'nonce-{RANDOM}' https://cdn.jsdelivr.net;\n  style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com;\n  img-src 'self' data: https:;\n  font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com;\n  connect-src 'self' https://*.example.com;\n  frame-src 'none';\n  object-src 'none';\n  base-uri 'self';\n```\n\nAdjust origins to the project. Do not cargo-cult this block unchanged.\n\n## XSS Prevention\n\n- Never inject unsanitized HTML\n- Avoid `innerHTML` / `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` unless sanitized first\n- Escape dynamic template values\n- Sanitize user HTML with a vetted local sanitizer when absolutely necessary\n\n## Third-Party Scripts\n\n- Load asynchronously\n- Use SRI when serving from a CDN\n- Audit quarterly\n- Prefer self-hosting for critical dependencies when practical\n\n## HTTPS and Headers\n\n```text\nStrict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload\nX-Content-Type-Options: nosniff\nX-Frame-Options: DENY\nReferrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin\nPermissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()\n```\n\n## Forms\n\n- CSRF protection on state-changing forms\n- Rate limiting on submission endpoints\n- Validate client and server side\n- Prefer honeypots or light anti-abuse controls over heavy-handed CAPTCHA defaults\n",
      "renderedContent": "<blockquote>\n<p>This file extends <a href=\"../common/security.md\">common/security.md<\/a> with web-specific security content.<\/p>\n<\/blockquote>\n<h1>Web Security Rules<\/h1>\n<h2>Content Security Policy<\/h2>\n<p>Always configure a production CSP.<\/p>\n<h3>Nonce-Based CSP<\/h3>\n<p>Use a per-request nonce for scripts instead of <code>&#39;unsafe-inline&#39;<\/code>.<\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-text\">Content-Security-Policy:\n  default-src &#39;self&#39;;\n  script-src &#39;self&#39; &#39;nonce-{RANDOM}&#39; https://cdn.jsdelivr.net;\n  style-src &#39;self&#39; &#39;unsafe-inline&#39; https://fonts.googleapis.com;\n  img-src &#39;self&#39; data: https:;\n  font-src &#39;self&#39; https://fonts.gstatic.com;\n  connect-src &#39;self&#39; https://*.example.com;\n  frame-src &#39;none&#39;;\n  object-src &#39;none&#39;;\n  base-uri &#39;self&#39;;\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<p>Adjust origins to the project. Do not cargo-cult this block unchanged.<\/p>\n<h2>XSS Prevention<\/h2>\n<ul>\n<li>Never inject unsanitized HTML<\/li>\n<li>Avoid <code>innerHTML<\/code> / <code>dangerouslySetInnerHTML<\/code> unless sanitized first<\/li>\n<li>Escape dynamic template values<\/li>\n<li>Sanitize user HTML with a vetted local sanitizer when absolutely necessary<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>Third-Party Scripts<\/h2>\n<ul>\n<li>Load asynchronously<\/li>\n<li>Use SRI when serving from a CDN<\/li>\n<li>Audit quarterly<\/li>\n<li>Prefer self-hosting for critical dependencies when practical<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>HTTPS and Headers<\/h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-text\">Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload\nX-Content-Type-Options: nosniff\nX-Frame-Options: DENY\nReferrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin\nPermissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h2>Forms<\/h2>\n<ul>\n<li>CSRF protection on state-changing forms<\/li>\n<li>Rate limiting on submission endpoints<\/li>\n<li>Validate client and server side<\/li>\n<li>Prefer honeypots or light anti-abuse controls over heavy-handed CAPTCHA defaults<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n"
    },

      "metadata": {},
      "risks": [],
      "contentPreview": "> This file extends common/testing.md with web-specific testing content.\nScreenshot key breakpoints: 320, 768, 1024, 1440\nTest hero sections, scrollytelling sections, and meaningful states\nUse Playwright screenshots for visual-heavy work\nIf both themes exist, test both\nRun automated accessibility ch",
      "rawContent": "> This file extends [common/testing.md](../common/testing.md) with web-specific testing content.\n\n# Web Testing Rules\n\n## Priority Order\n\n### 1. Visual Regression\n\n- Screenshot key breakpoints: 320, 768, 1024, 1440\n- Test hero sections, scrollytelling sections, and meaningful states\n- Use Playwright screenshots for visual-heavy work\n- If both themes exist, test both\n\n### 2. Accessibility\n\n- Run automated accessibility checks\n- Test keyboard navigation\n- Verify reduced-motion behavior\n- Verify color contrast\n\n### 3. Performance\n\n- Run Lighthouse or equivalent against meaningful pages\n- Keep CWV targets from [performance.md](performance.md)\n\n### 4. Cross-Browser\n\n- Minimum: Chrome, Firefox, Safari\n- Test scrolling, motion, and fallback behavior\n\n### 5. Responsive\n\n- Test 320, 375, 768, 1024, 1440, 1920\n- Verify no overflow\n- Verify touch interactions\n\n## E2E Shape\n\n```ts\nimport { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';\n\ntest('landing hero loads', async ({ page }) => {\n  await page.goto('/');\n  await expect(page.locator('h1')).toBeVisible();\n});\n```\n\n- Avoid flaky timeout-based assertions\n- Prefer deterministic waits\n\n## Unit Tests\n\n- Test utilities, data transforms, and custom hooks\n- For highly visual components, visual regression often carries more signal than brittle markup assertions\n- Visual regression supplements coverage targets; it does not replace them\n",

Visual Regression<\/h3>\n<ul>\n<li>Screenshot key breakpoints: 320, 768, 1024, 1440<\/li>\n<li>Test hero sections, scrollytelling sections, and meaningful states<\/li>\n<li>Use Playwright screenshots for visual-heavy work<\/li>\n<li>If both themes exist, test both<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h3>2. Performance<\/h3>\n<ul>\n<li>Run Lighthouse or equivalent against meaningful pages<\/li>\n<li>Keep CWV targets from <a href=\"performance.md\">performance.md<\/a><\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h3>4. Cross-Browser<\/h3>\n<ul>\n<li>Minimum: Chrome, Firefox, Safari<\/li>\n<li>Test scrolling, motion, and fallback behavior<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h3>5. Responsive<\/h3>\n<ul>\n<li>Test 320, 375, 768, 1024, 1440, 1920<\/li>\n<li>Verify no overflow<\/li>\n<li>Verify touch interactions<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>E2E Shape<\/h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-ts\">import { test, expect } from &#39;@playwright/test&#39;;\n\ntest(&#39;landing hero loads&#39;, async ({ page }) =&gt; {\n  await page.goto(&#39;/&#39;);\n  await expect(page.locator(&#39;h1&#39;)).toBeVisible();\n});\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<ul>\n<li>Avoid flaky timeout-based assertions<\/li>\n<li>Prefer deterministic waits<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>Unit Tests<\/h2>\n<ul>\n<li>Test utilities, data transforms, and custom hooks<\/li>\n<li>For highly visual components, visual regression often carries more signal than brittle markup assertions<\/li>\n<li>Visual regression supplements coverage targets; it does not replace them<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n"

      "contentPreview": "规则按**通用**层和**语言特定**目录组织：\n**common/** 包含通用原则 — 无语言特定的代码示例。\n**zh/** 包含 common 目录的中文翻译版本。\n**语言目录** 扩展通用规则，包含框架特定的模式、工具和代码示例。每个文件引用其对应的通用版本。\n> **重要提示：** 复制整个目录 — 不要使用  展开。\n> 通用和语言特定目录包含同名文件。\n> 将它们展开到一个目录会导致语言特定文件覆盖通用规则，\n> 并破坏语言特定文件使用的  相对引用。\n**规则** 定义广泛适用的标准、约定和检查清单（如\"80% 测试覆盖率\"、\"禁止硬编码密钥\"）。\n**技能**（ 目录）为",
      "rawContent": "# 规则\n\n## 结构\n\n规则按**通用**层和**语言特定**目录组织：\n\n```\nrules/\n├── common/          # 语言无关的原则（始终安装）\n│   ├── coding-style.md\n│   ├── git-workflow.md\n│   ├── testing.md\n│   ├── performance.md\n│   ├── patterns.md\n│   ├── hooks.md\n│   ├── agents.md\n│   ├── security.md\n│   ├── code-review.md\n│   └── development-workflow.md\n├── zh/              # 中文翻译版本\n│   ├── coding-style.md\n│   ├── git-workflow.md\n│   ├── testing.md\n│   ├── performance.md\n│   ├── patterns.md\n│   ├── hooks.md\n│   ├── agents.md\n│   ├── security.md\n│   ├── code-review.md\n│   └── development-workflow.md\n├── typescript/      # TypeScript/JavaScript 特定\n├── python/          # Python 特定\n├── golang/          # Go 特定\n├── swift/           # Swift 特定\n└── php/             # PHP 特定\n```\n\n- **common/** 包含通用原则 — 无语言特定的代码示例。\n- **zh/** 包含 common 目录的中文翻译版本。\n- **语言目录** 扩展通用规则，包含框架特定的模式、工具和代码示例。每个文件引用其对应的通用版本。\n\n## 安装\n\n### 选项 1：安装脚本（推荐）\n\n```bash\n# 安装通用 + 一个或多个语言特定的规则集\n./install.sh typescript\n./install.sh python\n./install.sh golang\n./install.sh swift\n./install.sh php\n\n# 同时安装多种语言\n./install.sh typescript python\n```\n\n### 选项 2：手动安装\n\n> **重要提示：** 复制整个目录 — 不要使用 `/*` 展开。\n> 通用和语言特定目录包含同名文件。\n> 将它们展开到一个目录会导致语言特定文件覆盖通用规则，\n> 并破坏语言特定文件使用的 `../common/` 相对引用。\n\n```bash\n# 创建目标目录\nmkdir -p ~/.claude/rules\n\n# 安装通用规则（所有项目必需）\ncp -r rules/common ~/.claude/rules/common\n\n# 安装中文翻译版本（可选）\ncp -r rules/zh ~/.claude/rules/zh\n\n# 根据项目技术栈安装语言特定规则\ncp -r rules/typescript ~/.claude/rules/typescript\ncp -r rules/python ~/.claude/rules/python\ncp -r rules/golang ~/.claude/rules/golang\ncp -r rules/swift ~/.claude/rules/swift\ncp -r rules/php ~/.claude/rules/php\n```\n\n## 规则 vs 技能\n\n- **规则** 定义广泛适用的标准、约定和检查清单（如\"80% 测试覆盖率\"、\"禁止硬编码密钥\"）。\n- **技能**（`skills/` 目录）为特定任务提供深入、可操作的参考材料（如 `python-patterns`、`golang-testing`）。\n\n语言特定的规则文件在适当的地方引用相关技能。规则告诉你*做什么*；技能告诉你*怎么做*。\n\n## 规则优先级\n\n当语言特定规则与通用规则冲突时，**语言特定规则优先**（特定覆盖通用）。这遵循标准的分层配置模式（类似于 CSS 特异性或 `.gitignore` 优先级）。\n\n- `rules/common/` 定义适用于所有项目的通用默认值。\n- `rules/golang/`、`rules/python/`、`rules/swift/`、`rules/php/`、`rules/typescript/` 等在语言习惯不同时覆盖这些默认值。\n- `rules/zh/` 是通用规则的中文翻译，与英文版本内容一致。\n\n### 示例\n\n`common/coding-style.md` 推荐不可变性作为默认原则。语言特定的 `golang/coding-style.md` 可以覆盖这一点：\n\n> 惯用的 Go 使用指针接收器进行结构体变更 — 参见 [common/coding-style.md](../common/coding-style.md) 了解通用原则，但这里首选符合 Go 习惯的变更方式。\n\n### 带覆盖说明的通用规则\n\n`rules/common/` 中可能被语言特定文件覆盖的规则会被标记：\n\n> **语言说明**：此规则可能会被语言特定规则覆盖；对于某些语言，该模式可能并不符合惯用写法。\n",

      "contentPreview": "位于 ：\n| 代理 | 用途 | 何时使用 |\n|-------|---------|------------|\n| planner | 实现规划 | 复杂功能、重构 |\n| architect | 系统设计 | 架构决策 |\n| tdd-guide | 测试驱动开发 | 新功能、bug 修复 |\n| code-reviewer | 代码审查 | 编写代码后 |\n| security-reviewer | 安全分析 | 提交前 |\n| build-error-resolver | 修复构建错误 | 构建失败时 |\n| e2e-runner | E2E 测试 | 关键用户流程 |\n| refac",
      "rawContent": "# 代理编排\n\n## 可用代理\n\n位于 `~/.claude/agents/`：\n\n| 代理 | 用途 | 何时使用 |\n|-------|---------|------------|\n| planner | 实现规划 | 复杂功能、重构 |\n| architect | 系统设计 | 架构决策 |\n| tdd-guide | 测试驱动开发 | 新功能、bug 修复 |\n| code-reviewer | 代码审查 | 编写代码后 |\n| security-reviewer | 安全分析 | 提交前 |\n| build-error-resolver | 修复构建错误 | 构建失败时 |\n| e2e-runner | E2E 测试 | 关键用户流程 |\n| refactor-cleaner | 死代码清理 | 代码维护 |\n| doc-updater | 文档 | 更新文档 |\n| rust-reviewer | Rust 代码审查 | Rust 项目 |\n\n## 立即使用代理\n\n无需用户提示：\n1. 复杂功能请求 - 使用 **planner** 代理\n2. 刚编写/修改的代码 - 使用 **code-reviewer** 代理\n3. Bug 修复或新功能 - 使用 **tdd-guide** 代理\n4. 架构决策 - 使用 **architect** 代理\n\n## 并行任务执行\n\n对独立操作始终使用并行 Task 执行：\n\n```markdown\n# 好：并行执行\n同时启动 3 个代理：\n1. 代理 1：认证模块安全分析\n2. 代理 2：缓存系统性能审查\n3. 代理 3：工具类型检查\n\n# 坏：不必要的顺序\n先代理 1，然后代理 2，然后代理 3\n```\n\n## 多视角分析\n\n对于复杂问题，使用分角色子代理：\n- 事实审查者\n- 高级工程师\n- 安全专家\n- 一致性审查者\n- 冗余检查者\n",
      "renderedContent": "<h1>代理编排<\/h1>\n<h2>可用代理<\/h2>\n<p>位于 <code>~/.claude/agents/<\/code>：<\/p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>代理<\/th>\n<th>用途<\/th>\n<th>何时使用<\/th>\n<\/tr>\n<\/thead>\n<tbody><tr>\n<td>planner<\/td>\n<td>实现规划<\/td>\n<td>复杂功能、重构<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<tr>\n<td>architect<\/td>\n<td>系统设计<\/td>\n<td>架构决策<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<tr>\n<td>tdd-guide<\/td>\n<td>测试驱动开发<\/td>\n<td>新功能、bug 修复<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<tr>\n<td>code-reviewer<\/td>\n<td>代码审查<\/td>\n<td>编写代码后<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<tr>\n<td>security-reviewer<\/td>\n<td>安全分析<\/td>\n<td>提交前<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<tr>\n<td>build-error-resolver<\/td>\n<td>修复构建错误<\/td>\n<td>构建失败时<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<tr>\n<td>e2e-runner<\/td>\n<td>E2E 测试<\/td>\n<td>关键用户流程<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<tr>\n<td>refactor-cleaner<\/td>\n<td>死代码清理<\/td>\n<td>代码维护<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<tr>\n<td>doc-updater<\/td>\n<td>文档<\/td>\n<td>更新文档<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<tr>\n<td>rust-reviewer<\/td>\n<td>Rust 代码审查<\/td>\n<td>Rust 项目<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<\/tbody><\/table>\n<h2>立即使用代理<\/h2>\n<p>无需用户提示：<\/p>\n<ol>\n<li>复杂功能请求 - 使用 <strong>planner<\/strong> 代理<\/li>\n<li>刚编写/修改的代码 - 使用 <strong>code-reviewer<\/strong> 代理<\/li>\n<li>Bug 修复或新功能 - 使用 <strong>tdd-guide<\/strong> 代理<\/li>\n<li>架构决策 - 使用 <strong>architect<\/strong> 代理<\/li>\n<\/ol>\n<h2>并行任务执行<\/h2>\n<p>对独立操作始终使用并行 Task 执行：<\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-markdown\"># 好：并行执行\n同时启动 3 个代理：\n1. 代理 1：认证模块安全分析\n2. 代理 2：缓存系统性能审查\n3. 代理 3：工具类型检查\n\n# 坏：不必要的顺序\n先代理 1，然后代理 2，然后代理 3\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h2>多视角分析<\/h2>\n<p>对于复杂问题，使用分角色子代理：<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>事实审查者<\/li>\n<li>高级工程师<\/li>\n<li>安全专家<\/li>\n<li>一致性审查者<\/li>\n<li>冗余检查者<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n"

      "description": "代码审查确保代码合并前的质量、安全性和可维护性。此规则定义何时以及如何进行代码审查。 **强制审查触发条件：** 编写或修改代码后 提交到共享分支之前 更改安全敏感代码时（认证、支付、用户数据） 进行架构更改时 合并 pull reques",

      "contentPreview": "代码审查确保代码合并前的质量、安全性和可维护性。此规则定义何时以及如何进行代码审查。\n**强制审查触发条件：**\n编写或修改代码后\n提交到共享分支之前\n更改安全敏感代码时（认证、支付、用户数据）\n进行架构更改时\n合并 pull request 之前\n**审查前要求：**\n在请求审查之前，确保：\n所有自动化检查（CI/CD）已通过\n合并冲突已解决\n分支已与目标分支同步\n在标记代码完成之前：\n[ ] 代码可读且命名良好\n[ ] 函数聚焦（<50 行）\n[ ] 文件内聚（<800 行）\n[ ] 无深层嵌套（>4 层）\n[ ] 错误显式处理\n[ ] 无硬编码密钥或凭据\n[ ] 无 console.lo",
      "rawContent": "# 代码审查标准\n\n## 目的\n\n代码审查确保代码合并前的质量、安全性和可维护性。此规则定义何时以及如何进行代码审查。\n\n## 何时审查\n\n**强制审查触发条件：**\n\n- 编写或修改代码后\n- 提交到共享分支之前\n- 更改安全敏感代码时（认证、支付、用户数据）\n- 进行架构更改时\n- 合并 pull request 之前\n\n**审查前要求：**\n\n在请求审查之前，确保：\n\n- 所有自动化检查（CI/CD）已通过\n- 合并冲突已解决\n- 分支已与目标分支同步\n\n## 审查检查清单\n\n在标记代码完成之前：\n\n- [ ] 代码可读且命名良好\n- [ ] 函数聚焦（<50 行）\n- [ ] 文件内聚（<800 行）\n- [ ] 无深层嵌套（>4 层）\n- [ ] 错误显式处理\n- [ ] 无硬编码密钥或凭据\n- [ ] 无 console.log 或调试语句\n- [ ] 新功能有测试\n- [ ] 测试覆盖率满足 80% 最低要求\n\n## 安全审查触发条件\n\n**停止并使用 security-reviewer 代理当：**\n\n- 认证或授权代码\n- 用户输入处理\n- 数据库查询\n- 文件系统操作\n- 外部 API 调用\n- 加密操作\n- 支付或金融代码\n\n## 审查严重级别\n\n| 级别 | 含义 | 行动 |\n|-------|---------|--------|\n| CRITICAL（关键） | 安全漏洞或数据丢失风险 | **阻止** - 合并前必须修复 |\n| HIGH（高） | Bug 或重大质量问题 | **警告** - 合并前应修复 |\n| MEDIUM（中） | 可维护性问题 | **信息** - 考虑修复 |\n| LOW（低） | 风格或次要建议 | **注意** - 可选 |\n\n## 代理使用\n\n使用这些代理进行代码审查：\n\n| 代理 | 用途 |\n|-------|--------|\n| **code-reviewer** | 通用代码质量、模式、最佳实践 |\n| **security-reviewer** | 安全漏洞、OWASP Top 10 |\n| **typescript-reviewer** | TypeScript/JavaScript 特定问题 |\n| **python-reviewer** | Python 特定问题 |\n| **go-reviewer** | Go 特定问题 |\n| **rust-reviewer** | Rust 特定问题 |\n\n## 审查工作流\n\n```\n1. 运行 git diff 了解更改\n2. 先检查安全检查清单\n3. 审查代码质量检查清单\n4. 运行相关测试\n5. 验证覆盖率 >= 80%\n6. 使用适当的代理进行详细审查\n```\n\n## 常见问题捕获\n\n### 安全\n\n- 硬编码凭据（API 密钥、密码、令牌）\n- SQL 注入（查询中的字符串拼接）\n- XSS 漏洞（未转义的用户输入）\n- 路径遍历（未净化的文件路径）\n- CSRF 保护缺失\n- 认证绕过\n\n### 代码质量\n\n- 大函数（>50 行）- 拆分为更小的\n- 大文件（>800 行）- 提取模块\n- 深层嵌套（>4 层）- 使用提前返回\n- 缺少错误处理 - 显式处理\n- 变更模式 - 优先使用不可变操作\n- 缺少测试 - 添加测试覆盖\n\n### 性能\n\n- N+1 查询 - 使用 JOIN 或批处理\n- 缺少分页 - 给查询添加 LIMIT\n- 无界查询 - 添加约束\n- 缺少缓存 - 缓存昂贵操作\n\n## 批准标准\n\n- **批准**：无关键或高优先级问题\n- **警告**：仅有高优先级问题（谨慎合并）\n- **阻止**：发现关键问题\n\n## 与其他规则的集成\n\n此规则与以下规则配合：\n\n- [testing.md](testing.md) - 测试覆盖率要求\n- [security.md](security.md) - 安全检查清单\n- [git-workflow.md](git-workflow.md) - 提交标准\n- [agents.md](agents.md) - 代理委托\n",
      "renderedContent": "<h1>代码审查标准<\/h1>\n<h2>目的<\/h2>\n<p>代码审查确保代码合并前的质量、安全性和可维护性。此规则定义何时以及如何进行代码审查。<\/p>\n<h2>何时审查<\/h2>\n<p><strong>强制审查触发条件：<\/strong><\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>编写或修改代码后<\/li>\n<li>提交到共享分支之前<\/li>\n<li>更改安全敏感代码时（认证、支付、用户数据）<\/li>\n<li>进行架构更改时<\/li>\n<li>合并 pull request 之前<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<p><strong>审查前要求：<\/strong><\/p>\n<p>在请求审查之前，确保：<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>所有自动化检查（CI/CD）已通过<\/li>\n<li>合并冲突已解决<\/li>\n<li>分支已与目标分支同步<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>审查检查清单<\/h2>\n<p>在标记代码完成之前：<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li><input disabled=\"\" type=\"checkbox\"> 代码可读且命名良好<\/li>\n<li><input disabled=\"\" type=\"checkbox\"> 函数聚焦（&lt;50 行）<\/li>\n<li><input disabled=\"\" type=\"checkbox\"> 文件内聚（&lt;800 行）<\/li>\n<li><input disabled=\"\" type=\"checkbox\"> 无深层嵌套（&gt;4 层）<\/li>\n<li><input disabled=\"\" type=\"checkbox\"> 错误显式处理<\/li>\n<li><input disabled=\"\" type=\"checkbox\"> 无硬编码密钥或凭据<\/li>\n<li><input disabled=\"\" type=\"checkbox\"> 无 console.log 或调试语句<\/li>\n<li><input disabled=\"\" type=\"checkbox\"> 新功能有测试<\/li>\n<li><input disabled=\"\" type=\"checkbox\"> 测试覆盖率满足 80% 最低要求<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>安全审查触发条件<\/h2>\n<p><strong>停止并使用 security-reviewer 代理当：<\/strong><\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>认证或授权代码<\/li>\n<li>用户输入处理<\/li>\n<li>数据库查询<\/li>\n<li>文件系统操作<\/li>\n<li>外部 API 调用<\/li>\n<li>加密操作<\/li>\n<li>支付或金融代码<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>审查严重级别<\/h2>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>级别<\/th>\n<th>含义<\/th>\n<th>行动<\/th>\n<\/tr>\n<\/thead>\n<tbody><tr>\n<td>CRITICAL（关键）<\/td>\n<td>安全漏洞或数据丢失风险<\/td>\n<td><strong>阻止<\/strong> - 合并前必须修复<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<tr>\n<td>HIGH（高）<\/td>\n<td>Bug 或重大质量问题<\/td>\n<td><strong>警告<\/strong> - 合并前应修复<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<tr>\n<td>MEDIUM（中）<\/td>\n<td>可维护性问题<\/td>\n<td><strong>信息<\/strong> - 考虑修复<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<tr>\n<td>LOW（低）<\/td>\n<td>风格或次要建议<\/td>\n<td><strong>注意<\/strong> - 可选<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<\/tbody><\/table>\n<h2>代理使用<\/h2>\n<p>使用这些代理进行代码审查：<\/p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>代理<\/th>\n<th>用途<\/th>\n<\/tr>\n<\/thead>\n<tbody><tr>\n<td><strong>code-reviewer<\/strong><\/td>\n<td>通用代码质量、模式、最佳实践<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<tr>\n<td><strong>security-reviewer<\/strong><\/td>\n<td>安全漏洞、OWASP Top 10<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<tr>\n<td><strong>typescript-reviewer<\/strong><\/td>\n<td>TypeScript/JavaScript 特定问题<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<tr>\n<td><strong>python-reviewer<\/strong><\/td>\n<td>Python 特定问题<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<tr>\n<td><strong>go-reviewer<\/strong><\/td>\n<td>Go 特定问题<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<tr>\n<td><strong>rust-reviewer<\/strong><\/td>\n<td>Rust 特定问题<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<\/tbody><\/table>\n<h2>审查工作流<\/h2>\n<pre><code>1. 运行 git diff 了解更改\n2. 先检查安全检查清单\n3. 审查代码质量检查清单\n4. 运行相关测试\n5. 验证覆盖率 &gt;= 80%\n6. 使用适当的代理进行详细审查\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h2>常见问题捕获<\/h2>\n<h3>安全<\/h3>\n<ul>\n<li>硬编码凭据（API 密钥、密码、令牌）<\/li>\n<li>SQL 注入（查询中的字符串拼接）<\/li>\n<li>XSS 漏洞（未转义的用户输入）<\/li>\n<li>路径遍历（未净化的文件路径）<\/li>\n<li>CSRF 保护缺失<\/li>\n<li>认证绕过<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h3>代码质量<\/h3>\n<ul>\n<li>大函数（&gt;50 行）- 拆分为更小的<\/li>\n<li>大文件（&gt;800 行）- 提取模块<\/li>\n<li>深层嵌套（&gt;4 层）- 使用提前返回<\/li>\n<li>缺少错误处理 - 显式处理<\/li>\n<li>变更模式 - 优先使用不可变操作<\/li>\n<li>缺少测试 - 添加测试覆盖<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h3>性能<\/h3>\n<ul>\n<li>N+1 查询 - 使用 JOIN 或批处理<\/li>\n<li>缺少分页 - 给查询添加 LIMIT<\/li>\n<li>无界查询 - 添加约束<\/li>\n<li>缺少缓存 - 缓存昂贵操作<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>批准标准<\/h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>批准<\/strong>：无关键或高优先级问题<\/li>\n<li><strong>警告<\/strong>：仅有高优先级问题（谨慎合并）<\/li>\n<li><strong>阻止<\/strong>：发现关键问题<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>与其他规则的集成<\/h2>\n<p>此规则与以下规则配合：<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li><a href=\"testing.md\">testing.md<\/a> -       "title": "编码风格",
      "description": "始终创建新对象，永远不要修改现有对象： 原理：不可变数据防止隐藏的副作用，使调试更容易，并启用安全的并发。 多个小文件 > 少量大文件： 高内聚，低耦合 典型 200-400 行，最多 800 行 从大模块中提取工具函数 按功能/领域组织，",
      "metadata": {},
      "risks": [],
      "contentPreview": "始终创建新对象，永远不要修改现有对象：\n原理：不可变数据防止隐藏的副作用，使调试更容易，并启用安全的并发。\n多个小文件 > 少量大文件：\n高内聚，低耦合\n典型 200-400 行，最多 800 行\n从大模块中提取工具函数\n按功能/领域组织，而非按类型\n始终全面处理错误：\n在每一层显式处理错误\n在面向 UI 的代码中提供用户友好的错误消息\n在服务器端记录详细的错误上下文\n永远不要静默吞掉错误\n始终在系统边界验证：\n处理前验证所有用户输入\n在可用的情况下使用基于模式的验证\n快速失败并给出清晰的错误消息\n永远不要信任外部数据（API 响应、用户输入、文件内容）\n在标记工作完成前：\n[ ] 代码可读且",
      "rawContent": "# 编码风格\n\n## 不可变性（关键）\n\n始终创建新对象，永远不要修改现有对象：\n\n```\n// 伪代码\n错误:  modify(original, field, value) → 就地修改 original\n正确: update(original, field, value) → 返回带有更改的新副本\n```\n\n原理：不可变数据防止隐藏的副作用，使调试更容易，并启用安全的并发。\n\n## 文件组织\n\n多个小文件 > 少量大文件：\n- 高内聚，低耦合\n- 典型 200-400 行，最多 800 行\n- 从大模块中提取工具函数\n- 按功能/领域组织，而非按类型\n\n## 错误处理\n\n始终全面处理错误：\n- 在每一层显式处理错误\n- 在面向 UI 的代码中提供用户友好的错误消息\n- 在服务器端记录详细的错误上下文\n- 永远不要静默吞掉错误\n\n## 输入验证\n\n始终在系统边界验证：\n- 处理前验证所有用户输入\n- 在可用的情况下使用基于模式的验证\n- 快速失败并给出清晰的错误消息\n- 永远不要信任外部数据（API 响应、用户输入、文件内容）\n\n## 代码质量检查清单\n\n在标记工作完成前：\n- [ ] 代码可读且命名良好\n- [ ] 函数很小（<50 行）\n- [ ] 文件聚焦（<800 行）\n- [ ] 没有深层嵌套（>4 层）\n- [ ] 正确的错误处理\n- [ ] 没有硬编码值（使用常量或配置）\n- [ ] 没有变更（使用不可变模式）\n",
      "renderedContent": "<h1>编码风格<\/h1>\n<h2>不可变性（关键）<\/h2>\n<p>始终创建新对象，永远不要修改现有对象：<\/p>\n<pre><code>// 伪代码\n错误:  modify(original, field, value) → 就地修改 original\n正确: update(original, field, value) → 返回带有更改的新副本\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<p>原理：不可变数据防止隐藏的副作用，使调试更容易，并启用安全的并发。<\/p>\n<h2>文件组织<\/h2>\n<p>多个小文件 &gt; 少量大文件：<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>高内聚，低耦合<\/li>\n<li>典型 200-400 行，最多 800 行<\/li>\n<li>从大模块中提取工具函数<\/li>\n<li>按功能/领域组织，而非按类型<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>错误处理<\/h2>\n<p>始终全面处理错误：<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>在每一层显式处理错误<\/li>\n<li>在面向 UI 的代码中提供用户友好的错误消息<\/li>\n<li>在服务器端记录详细的错误上下文<\/li>\n<li>永远不要静默吞掉错误<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>输入验证<\/h2>\n<p>始终在系统边界验证：<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>处理前验证所有用户输入<\/li>\n<li>在可用的情况下使用基于模式的验证<\/li>\n<li>快速失败并给出清晰的错误消息<\/li>\n<li>永远不要信任外部数据（API 响应、用户输入、文件内容）<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>代码质量检查清单<\/h2>\n<p>在标记工作完成前：<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li><input disabled=\"\" type=\"checkbox\"> 代码可读且命名良好<\/li>\n<li><input disabled=\"\" type=\"checkbox\"> 函数很小（&lt;50 行）<\/li>\n<li><input disabled=\"\" type=\"checkbox\"> 文件聚焦（&lt;800 行）<\/li>\n<li><input disabled=\"\" type=\"checkbox\"> 没有深层嵌套（&gt;4 层）<\/li>\n<li><input disabled=\"\" type=\"checkbox\"> 正确的错误处理<\/li>\n<li><input disabled=\"\" type=\"checkbox\"> 没有硬编码值（使用常量或配置）<\/li>\n<li><input disabled=\"\" type=\"checkbox\"> 没有变更（使用不可变模式）<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n"

      "description": "> 此文件扩展 common/git-workflow.md，包含 git 操作之前的完整功能开发流程。 功能实现工作流描述了开发管道：研究、规划、TDD、代码审查，然后提交到 git。 0. **研究与重用** _(任何新实现前必需)_ ",
      "metadata": {},
      "risks": [],
      "contentPreview": "> 此文件扩展 common/git-workflow.md，包含 git 操作之前的完整功能开发流程。\n功能实现工作流描述了开发管道：研究、规划、TDD、代码审查，然后提交到 git。\n0. **研究与重用** _(任何新实现前必需)_\n   - **GitHub 代码搜索优先：** 在编写任何新代码之前，运行  和  查找现有实现、模板和模式。\n   - **库文档其次：** 使用 Context7 或主要供应商文档确认 API 行为、包使用和版本特定细节。\n   - **仅当前两者不足时使用 Exa：** 在 GitHub 搜索和主要文档之后，使用 Exa 进行更广泛的网络研究或发现。\n",
      "rawContent": "# 开发工作流\n\n> 此文件扩展 [common/git-workflow.md](./git-workflow.md)，包含 git 操作之前的完整功能开发流程。\n\n功能实现工作流描述了开发管道：研究、规划、TDD、代码审查，然后提交到 git。\n\n## 功能实现工作流\n\n0. **研究与重用** _(任何新实现前必需)_\n   - **GitHub 代码搜索优先：** 在编写任何新代码之前，运行 `gh search repos` 和 `gh search code` 查找现有实现、模板和模式。\n   - **库文档其次：** 使用 Context7 或主要供应商文档确认 API 行为、包使用和版本特定细节。\n   - **仅当前两者不足时使用 Exa：** 在 GitHub 搜索和主要文档之后，使用 Exa 进行更广泛的网络研究或发现。\n   - **检查包注册表：** 在编写工具代码之前搜索 npm、PyPI、crates.io 和其他注册表。首选久经考验的库而非手工编写的解决方案。\n   - **搜索可适配的实现：** 寻找解决问题 80%+ 且可以分支、移植或包装的开源项目。\n   - 当满足需求时，优先采用或移植经验证的方法而非从头编写新代码。\n\n1. **先规划**\n   - 使用 **planner** 代理创建实现计划\n   - 编码前生成规划文档：PRD、架构、系统设计、技术文档、任务列表\n   - 识别依赖和风险\n   - 分解为阶段\n\n2. **TDD 方法**\n   - 使用 **tdd-guide** 代理\n   - 先写测试（RED）\n   - 实现以通过测试（GREEN）\n   - 重构（IMPROVE）\n   - 验证 80%+ 覆盖率\n\n3. **代码审查**\n   - 编写代码后立即使用 **code-reviewer** 代理\n   - 解决关键和高优先级问题\n   - 尽可能修复中优先级问题\n\n4. **提交与推送**\n   - 详细的提交消息\n   - 遵循约定式提交格式\n   - 参见 [git-workflow.md](./git-workflow.md) 了解提交消息格式和 PR 流程\n\n5. **审查前检查**\n   - 验证所有自动化检查（CI/CD）已通过\n   - 解决任何合并冲突\n   - 确保分支已与目标分支同步\n   - 仅在这些检查通过后请求审查\n",
      "renderedContent": "<h1>开发工作流<\/h1>\n<blockquote>\n<p>此文件扩展 <a href=\"./git-workflow.md\">common/git-workflow.md<\/a>，包含 git 操作之前的完整功能开发流程。<\/p>\n<\/blockquote>\n<p>功能实现工作流描述了开发管道：研究、规划、TDD、代码审查，然后提交到 git。<\/p>\n<h2>功能实现工作流<\/h2>\n<ol start=\"0\">\n<li><p><strong>研究与重用<\/strong> <em>(任何新实现前必需)<\/em><\/p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>GitHub 代码搜索优先：<\/strong> 在编写任何新代码之前，运行 <code>gh search repos<\/code> 和 <code>gh search code<\/code> 查找现有实现、模板和模式。<\/li>\n<li><strong>库文档其次：<\/strong> 使用 Context7 或主要供应商文档确认 API 行为、包使用和版本特定细节。<\/li>\n<li><strong>仅当前两者不足时使用 Exa：<\/strong> 在 GitHub 搜索和主要文档之后，使用 Exa 进行更广泛的网络研究或发现。<\/li>\n<li><strong>检查包注册表：<\/strong> 在编写工具代码之前搜索 npm、PyPI、crates.io 和其他注册表。首选久经考验的库而非手工编写的解决方案。<\/li>\n<li><strong>搜索可适配的实现：<\/strong> 寻找解决问题 80%+ 且可以分支、移植或包装的开源项目。<\/li>\n<li>当满足需求时，优先采用或移植经验证的方法而非从头编写新代码。<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<\/li>\n<li><p><strong>先规划<\/strong><\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>使用 <strong>planner<\/strong> 代理创建实现计划<\/li>\n<li>编码前生成规划文档：PRD、架构、系统设计、技术文档、任务列表<\/li>\n<li>识别依赖和风险<\/li>\n<li>分解为阶段<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<\/li>\n<li><p><strong>TDD 方法<\/strong><\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>使用 <strong>tdd-guide<\/strong> 代理<\/li>\n<li>先写测试（RED）<\/li>\n<li>实现以通过测试（GREEN）<\/li>\n<li>重构（IMPROVE）<\/li>\n<li>验证 80%+ 覆盖率<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<\/li>\n<li><p><strong>代码审查<\/strong><\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>编写代码后立即使用 <strong>code-reviewer<\/strong> 代理<\/li>\n<li>解决关键和高优先级问题<\/li>\n<li>尽可能修复中优先级问题<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<\/li>\n<li><p><strong>提交与推送<\/strong><\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>详细的提交消息<\/li>\n<li>遵循约定式提交格式<\/li>\n<li>参见 <a href=\"./git-workflow.md\">git-workflow.md<\/a> 了解提交消息格式和 PR 流程<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<\/li>\n<li><p><strong>审查前检查<\/strong><\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>验证所有自动化检查（CI/CD）已通过<\/li>\n<li>解决任何合并冲突<\/li>\n<li>确保分支已与目标分支同步<\/li>\n<li>仅在这些检查通过后请求审查<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<\/li>\n<\/ol>\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "rule",
      "subtype": "rule_md",
      "path": "rules/zh/git-workflow.md",
      "title": "Git 工作流",
      "description": "类型：feat, fix, refactor, docs, test, chore, perf, ci 注意：通过 ~/.claude/settings.json 全局禁用归属。 创建 PR 时： 1. 分析完整提交历史（不仅是最新提交） ",
      "metadata": {},
      "risks": [],
      "contentPreview": "类型：feat, fix, refactor, docs, test, chore, perf, ci\n注意：通过 ~/.claude/settings.json 全局禁用归属。\n创建 PR 时：\n1. 分析完整提交历史（不仅是最新提交）\n2. 使用  查看所有更改\n3. 起草全面的 PR 摘要\n4. 包含带有 TODO 的测试计划\n5. 如果是新分支，使用  标志推送\n> 对于 git 操作之前的完整开发流程（规划、TDD、代码审查），\n> 参见 development-workflow.md。",
      "rawContent": "# Git 工作流\n\n## 提交消息格式\n```\n<类型>: <描述>\n\n<可选正文>\n```\n\n类型：feat, fix, refactor, docs, test, chore, perf, ci\n\n注意：通过 ~/.claude/settings.json 全局禁用归属。\n\n## Pull Request 工作流\n\n创建 PR 时：\n1. 分析完整提交历史（不仅是最新提交）\n2. 使用 `git diff [base-branch]...HEAD` 查看所有更改\n3. 起草全面的 PR 摘要\n4. 包含带有 TODO 的测试计划\n5. 如果是新分支，使用 `-u` 标志推送\n\n> 对于 git 操作之前的完整开发流程（规划、TDD、代码审查），\n> 参见 [development-workflow.md](./development-workflow.md)。\n",
      "renderedContent": "<h1>Git 工作流<\/h1>\n<h2>提交消息格式<\/h2>\n<pre><code>&lt;类型&gt;: &lt;描述&gt;\n\n&lt;可选正文&gt;\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<p>类型：feat, fix, refactor, docs, test, chore, perf, ci<\/p>\n<p>注意：通过 ~/.claude/settings.json 全局禁用归属。<\/p>\n<h2>Pull Request 工作流<\/h2>\n<p>创建 PR 时：<\/p>\n<ol>\n<li>分析完整提交历史（不仅是最新提交）<\/li>\n<li>使用 <code>git diff [base-branch]...HEAD<\/code> 查看所有更改<\/li>\n<li>起草全面的 PR 摘要<\/li>\n<li>包含带有 TODO 的测试计划<\/li>\n<li>如果是新分支，使用 <code>-u<\/code> 标志推送<\/li>\n<\/ol>\n<blockquote>\n<p>对于 git 操作之前的完整开发流程（规划、TDD、代码审查），\n参见 <a href=\"./development-workflow.md\">development-workflow.md<\/a>。<\/p>\n<\/blockquote>\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "rule",
      "subtype": "rule_md",
      "path": "rules/zh/hooks.md",
      "title": "钩子系统",
      "description": "**PreToolUse**：工具执行前（验证、参数修改） **PostToolUse**：工具执行后（自动格式化、检查） **Stop**：会话结束时（最终验证） 谨慎使用： 为可信、定义明确的计划启用 探索性工作时禁用 永远不要使用 d",
      "metadata": {},
      "risks": [],
      "contentPreview": "**PreToolUse**：工具执行前（验证、参数修改）\n**PostToolUse**：工具执行后（自动格式化、检查）\n**Stop**：会话结束时（最终验证）\n谨慎使用：\n为可信、定义明确的计划启用\n探索性工作时禁用\n永远不要使用 dangerously-skip-permissions 标志\n改为在  中配置 \n使用 TodoWrite 工具：\n跟踪多步骤任务的进度\n验证对指令的理解\n启用实时引导\n显示细粒度的实现步骤\n待办列表揭示：\n顺序错误的步骤\n缺失的项目\n多余的不必要项目\n错误的粒度\n误解的需求",
      "rawContent": "# 钩子系统\n\n## 钩子类型\n\n- **PreToolUse**：工具执行前（验证、参数修改）\n- **PostToolUse**：工具执行后（自动格式化、检查）\n- **Stop**：会话结束时（最终验证）\n\n## 自动接受权限\n\n谨慎使用：\n- 为可信、定义明确的计划启用\n- 探索性工作时禁用\n- 永远不要使用 dangerously-skip-permissions 标志\n- 改为在 `~/.claude.json` 中配置 `allowedTools`\n\n## TodoWrite 最佳实践\n\n使用 TodoWrite 工具：\n- 跟踪多步骤任务的进度\n- 验证对指令的理解\n- 启用实时引导\n- 显示细粒度的实现步骤\n\n待办列表揭示：\n- 顺序错误的步骤\n- 缺失的项目\n- 多余的不必要项目\n- 错误的粒度\n- 误解的需求\n",
      "renderedContent": "<h1>钩子系统<\/h1>\n<h2>钩子类型<\/h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>PreToolUse<\/strong>：工具执行前（验证、参数修改）<\/li>\n<li><strong>PostToolUse<\/strong>：工具执行后（自动格式化、检查）<\/li>\n<li><strong>Stop<\/strong>：会话结束时（最终验证）<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>自动接受权限<\/h2>\n<p>谨慎使用：<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>为可信、定义明确的计划启用<\/li>\n<li>探索性工作时禁用<\/li>\n<li>永远不要使用 dangerously-skip-permissions 标志<\/li>\n<li>改为在 <code>~/.claude.json<\/code> 中配置 <code>allowedTools<\/code><\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>TodoWrite 最佳实践<\/h2>\n<p>使用 TodoWrite 工具：<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>跟踪多步骤任务的进度<\/li>\n<li>验证对指令的理解<\/li>\n<li>启用实时引导<\/li>\n<li>显示细粒度的实现步骤<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<p>待办列表揭示：<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>顺序错误的步骤<\/li>\n<li>缺失的项目<\/li>\n<li>多余的不必要项目<\/li>\n<li>错误的粒度<\/li>\n<li>误解的需求<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "rule",
      "subtype": "rule_md",
      "path": "rules/zh/patterns.md",
      "title": "常用模式",
      "description": "实现新功能时： 1. 搜索久经考验的骨架项目 2. 使用并行代理评估选项：    - 安全性评估    - 可扩展性分析    - 相关性评分    - 实现规划 3. 克隆最佳匹配作为基础 4. 在经验证的结构内迭代 将数据访问封装在一致",
      "metadata": {},
      "risks": [],
      "contentPreview": "实现新功能时：\n1. 搜索久经考验的骨架项目\n2. 使用并行代理评估选项：\n   - 安全性评估\n   - 可扩展性分析\n   - 相关性评分\n   - 实现规划\n3. 克隆最佳匹配作为基础\n4. 在经验证的结构内迭代\n将数据访问封装在一致的接口后面：\n定义标准操作：findAll、findById、create、update、delete\n具体实现处理存储细节（数据库、API、文件等）\n业务逻辑依赖抽象接口，而非存储机制\n便于轻松切换数据源，并简化使用模拟的测试\n对所有 API 响应使用一致的信封：\n包含成功/状态指示器\n包含数据负载（错误时可为空）\n包含错误消息字段（成功时可为空）\n包含分",
      "rawContent": "# 常用模式\n\n## 骨架项目\n\n实现新功能时：\n1. 搜索久经考验的骨架项目\n2. 使用并行代理评估选项：\n   - 安全性评估\n   - 可扩展性分析\n   - 相关性评分\n   - 实现规划\n3. 克隆最佳匹配作为基础\n4. 在经验证的结构内迭代\n\n## 设计模式\n\n### 仓储模式\n\n将数据访问封装在一致的接口后面：\n- 定义标准操作：findAll、findById、create、update、delete\n- 具体实现处理存储细节（数据库、API、文件等）\n- 业务逻辑依赖抽象接口，而非存储机制\n- 便于轻松切换数据源，并简化使用模拟的测试\n\n### API 响应格式\n\n对所有 API 响应使用一致的信封：\n- 包含成功/状态指示器\n- 包含数据负载（错误时可为空）\n- 包含错误消息字段（成功时可为空）\n- 包含分页响应的元数据（total、page、limit）\n",
      "renderedContent": "<h1>常用模式<\/h1>\n<h2>骨架项目<\/h2>\n<p>实现新功能时：<\/p>\n<ol>\n<li>搜索久经考验的骨架项目<\/li>\n<li>使用并行代理评估选项：<ul>\n<li>安全性评估<\/li>\n<li>可扩展性分析<\/li>\n<li>相关性评分<\/li>\n<li>实现规划<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<\/li>\n<li>克隆最佳匹配作为基础<\/li>\n<li>在经验证的结构内迭代<\/li>\n<\/ol>\n<h2>设计模式<\/h2>\n<h3>仓储模式<\/h3>\n<p>将数据访问封装在一致的接口后面：<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>定义标准操作：findAll、findById、create、update、delete<\/li>\n<li>具体实现处理存储细节（数据库、API、文件等）<\/li>\n<li>业务逻辑依赖抽象接口，而非存储机制<\/li>\n<li>便于轻松切换数据源，并简化使用模拟的测试<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h3>API 响应格式<\/h3>\n<p>对所有 API 响应使用一致的信封：<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>包含成功/状态指示器<\/li>\n<li>包含数据负载（错误时可为空）<\/li>\n<li>包含错误消息字段（成功时可为空）<\/li>\n<li>包含分页响应的元数据（total、page、limit）<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "rule",
      "subtype": "rule_md",
      "path": "rules/zh/performance.md",
      "title": "性能优化",
      "description": "**Haiku 4.5**（Sonnet 90% 的能力，3 倍成本节省）： 频繁调用的轻量级代理 结对编程和代码生成 多代理系统中的工作者代理 **Sonnet 4.6**（最佳编码模型）： 主要开发工作 编排多代理工作流 复杂编码任务 ",
      "metadata": {},
      "risks": [],
      "contentPreview": "**Haiku 4.5**（Sonnet 90% 的能力，3 倍成本节省）：\n频繁调用的轻量级代理\n结对编程和代码生成\n多代理系统中的工作者代理\n**Sonnet 4.6**（最佳编码模型）：\n主要开发工作\n编排多代理工作流\n复杂编码任务\n**Opus 4.5**（最深度推理）：\n复杂架构决策\n最大推理需求\n研究和分析任务\n避免在上下文窗口的最后 20% 进行以下操作：\n大规模重构\n跨多个文件的功能实现\n调试复杂交互\n上下文敏感度较低的任务：\n单文件编辑\n独立工具创建\n文档更新\n简单 bug 修复\n扩展思考默认启用，为内部推理保留最多 31,999 个 token。\n通过以下方式控制扩展思考：",
      "rawContent": "# 性能优化\n\n## 模型选择策略\n\n**Haiku 4.5**（Sonnet 90% 的能力，3 倍成本节省）：\n- 频繁调用的轻量级代理\n- 结对编程和代码生成\n- 多代理系统中的工作者代理\n\n**Sonnet 4.6**（最佳编码模型）：\n- 主要开发工作\n- 编排多代理工作流\n- 复杂编码任务\n\n**Opus 4.5**（最深度推理）：\n- 复杂架构决策\n- 最大推理需求\n- 研究和分析任务\n\n## 上下文窗口管理\n\n避免在上下文窗口的最后 20% 进行以下操作：\n- 大规模重构\n- 跨多个文件的功能实现\n- 调试复杂交互\n\n上下文敏感度较低的任务：\n- 单文件编辑\n- 独立工具创建\n- 文档更新\n- 简单 bug 修复\n\n## 扩展思考 + 规划模式\n\n扩展思考默认启用，为内部推理保留最多 31,999 个 token。\n\n通过以下方式控制扩展思考：\n- **切换**：Option+T（macOS）/ Alt+T（Windows/Linux）\n- **配置**：在 `~/.claude/settings.json` 中设置 `alwaysThinkingEnabled`\n- **预算上限**：`export MAX_THINKING_TOKENS=10000`\n- **详细模式**：Ctrl+O 查看思考输出\n\n对于需要深度推理的复杂任务：\n1. 确保扩展思考已启用（默认开启）\n2. 启用**规划模式**进行结构化方法\n3. 使用多轮审查进行彻底分析\n4. 使用分角色子代理获得多样化视角\n\n## 构建排查\n\n如果构建失败：\n1. 使用 **build-error-resolver** 代理\n2. 分析错误消息\n3. 增量修复\n4. 每次修复后验证\n",
      "renderedContent": "<h1>性能优化<\/h1>\n<h2>模型选择策略<\/h2>\n<p><strong>Haiku 4.5<\/strong>（Sonnet 90% 的能力，3 倍成本节省）：<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>频繁调用的轻量级代理<\/li>\n<li>结对编程和代码生成<\/li>\n<li>多代理系统中的工作者代理<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<p><strong>Sonnet 4.6<\/strong>（最佳编码模型）：<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>主要开发工作<\/li>\n<li>编排多代理工作流<\/li>\n<li>复杂编码任务<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<p><strong>Opus 4.5<\/strong>（最深度推理）：<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>复杂架构决策<\/li>\n<li>最大推理需求<\/li>\n<li>研究和分析任务<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>上下文窗口管理<\/h2>\n<p>避免在上下文窗口的最后 20% 进行以下操作：<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>大规模重构<\/li>\n<li>跨多个文件的功能实现<\/li>\n<li>调试复杂交互<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<p>上下文敏感度较低的任务：<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>单文件编辑<\/li>\n<li>独立工具创建<\/li>\n<li>文档更新<\/li>\n<li>简单 bug 修复<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>扩展思考 + 规划模式<\/h2>\n<p>扩展思考默认启用，为内部推理保留最多 31,999 个 token。<\/p>\n<p>通过以下方式控制扩展思考：<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>切换<\/strong>：Option+T（macOS）/ Alt+T（Windows/Linux）<\/li>\n<li><strong>配置<\/strong>：在 <code>~/.claude/settings.json<\/code> 中设置 <code>alwaysThinkingEnabled<\/code><\/li>\n<li><strong>预算上限<\/strong>：<code>export MAX_THINKING_TOKENS=10000<\/code><\/li>\n<li><strong>详细模式<\/strong>：Ctrl+O 查看思考输出<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<p>对于需要深度推理的复杂任务：<\/p>\n<ol>\n<li>确保扩展思考已启用（默认开启）<\/li>\n<li>启用<strong>规划模式<\/strong>进行结构化方法<\/li>\n<li>使用多轮审查进行彻底分析<\/li>\n<li>使用分角色子代理获得多样化视角<\/li>\n<\/ol>\n<h2>构建排查<\/h2>\n<p>如果构建失败：<\/p>\n<ol>\n<li>使用 <strong>build-error-resolver<\/strong> 代理<\/li>\n<li>分析错误消息<\/li>\n<li>增量修复<\/li>\n<li>每次修复后验证<\/li>\n<\/ol>\n"
    },

      "metadata": {},

      "contentPreview": "在任何提交之前：\n[ ] 无硬编码密钥（API 密钥、密码、令牌）\n[ ] 所有用户输入已验证\n[ ] SQL 注入防护（参数化查询）\n[ ] XSS 防护（净化 HTML）\n[ ] CSRF 保护已启用\n[ ] 认证/授权已验证\n[ ] 所有端点启用速率限制\n[ ] 错误消息不泄露敏感数据\n永远不要在源代码中硬编码密钥\n始终使用环境变量或密钥管理器\n启动时验证所需的密钥是否存在\n轮换任何可能已暴露的密钥\n如果发现安全问题：\n1. 立即停止\n2. 使用 **security-reviewer** 代理\n3. 在继续之前修复关键问题\n4. 轮换任何已暴露的密钥\n5. 审查整个代码库中的类似问题",
      "rawContent": "# 安全指南\n\n## 强制安全检查\n\n在任何提交之前：\n- [ ] 无硬编码密钥（API 密钥、密码、令牌）\n- [ ] 所有用户输入已验证\n- [ ] SQL 注入防护（参数化查询）\n- [ ] XSS 防护（净化 HTML）\n- [ ] CSRF 保护已启用\n- [ ] 认证/授权已验证\n- [ ] 所有端点启用速率限制\n- [ ] 错误消息不泄露敏感数据\n\n## 密钥管理\n\n- 永远不要在源代码中硬编码密钥\n- 始终使用环境变量或密钥管理器\n- 启动时验证所需的密钥是否存在\n- 轮换任何可能已暴露的密钥\n\n## 安全响应协议\n\n如果发现安全问题：\n1. 立即停止\n2. 使用 **security-reviewer** 代理\n3. 在继续之前修复关键问题\n4. 轮换任何已暴露的密钥\n5. 审查整个代码库中的类似问题\n",
      "renderedContent": "<h1>安全指南<\/h1>\n<h2>强制安全检查<\/h2>\n<p>在任何提交之前：<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li><input disabled=\"\" type=\"checkbox\"> 无硬编码密钥（API 密钥、密码、令牌）<\/li>\n<li><input disabled=\"\" type=\"checkbox\"> 所有用户输入已验证<\/li>\n<li><input disabled=\"\" type=\"checkbox\"> SQL 注入防护（参数化查询）<\/li>\n<li><input disabled=\"\" type=\"checkbox\"> XSS 防护（净化 HTML）<\/li>\n<li><input disabled=\"\" type=\"checkbox\"> CSRF 保护已启用<\/li>\n<li><input disabled=\"\" type=\"checkbox\"> 认证/授权已验证<\/li>\n<li><input disabled=\"\" type=\"checkbox\"> 所有端点启用速率限制<\/li>\n<li><input disabled=\"\" type=\"checkbox\"> 错误消息不泄露敏感数据<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>密钥管理<\/h2>\n<ul>\n<li>永远不要在源代码中硬编码密钥<\/li>\n<li>始终使用环境变量或密钥管理器<\/li>\n<li>启动时验证所需的密钥是否存在<\/li>\n<li>轮换任何可能已暴露的密钥<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>安全响应协议<\/h2>\n<p>如果发现安全问题：<\/p>\n<ol>\n<li>立即停止<\/li>\n<li>使用 <strong>security-reviewer<\/strong> 代理<\/li>\n<li>在继续之前修复关键问题<\/li>\n<li>轮换任何已暴露的密钥<\/li>\n<li>审查整个代码库中的类似问题<\/li>\n<\/ol>\n"

      "metadata": {},
      "risks": [],
      "contentPreview": "测试类型（全部必需）：\n1. **单元测试** - 单个函数、工具、组件\n2. **集成测试** - API 端点、数据库操作\n3. **E2E 测试** - 关键用户流程（框架根据语言选择）\n强制工作流：\n1. 先写测试（RED）\n2. 运行测试 - 应该失败\n3. 编写最小实现（GREEN）\n4. 运行测试 - 应该通过\n5. 重构（IMPROVE）\n6. 验证覆盖率（80%+）\n1. 使用 **tdd-guide** 代理\n2. 检查测试隔离\n3. 验证模拟是否正确\n4. 修复实现，而非测试（除非测试有误）\n**tdd-guide** - 主动用于新功能，强制先写测试",
      "rawContent": "# 测试要求\n\n## 最低测试覆盖率：80%\n\n测试类型（全部必需）：\n1. **单元测试** - 单个函数、工具、组件\n2. **集成测试** - API 端点、数据库操作\n3. **E2E 测试** - 关键用户流程（框架根据语言选择）\n\n## 测试驱动开发\n\n强制工作流：\n1. 先写测试（RED）\n2. 运行测试 - 应该失败\n3. 编写最小实现（GREEN）\n4. 运行测试 - 应该通过\n5. 重构（IMPROVE）\n6. 验证覆盖率（80%+）\n\n## 测试失败排查\n\n1. 使用 **tdd-guide** 代理\n2. 检查测试隔离\n3. 验证模拟是否正确\n4. 修复实现，而非测试（除非测试有误）\n\n## 代理支持\n\n- **tdd-guide** - 主动用于新功能，强制先写测试\n",
      "renderedContent": "<h1>测试要求<\/h1>\n<h2>最低测试覆盖率：80%<\/h2>\n<p>测试类型（全部必需）：<\/p>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>单元测试<\/strong> - 单个函数、工具、组件<\/li>\n<li><strong>集成测试<\/strong> - API 端点、数据库操作<\/li>\n<li><strong>E2E 测试<\/strong> - 关键用户流程（框架根据语言选择）<\/li>\n<\/ol>\n<h2>测试驱动开发<\/h2>\n<p>强制工作流：<\/p>\n<ol>\n<li>先写测试（RED）<\/li>\n<li>运行测试 - 应该失败<\/li>\n<li>编写最小实现（GREEN）<\/li>\n<li>运行测试 - 应该通过<\/li>\n<li>重构（IMPROVE）<\/li>\n<li>验证覆盖率（80%+）<\/li>\n<\/ol>\n<h2>测试失败排查<\/h2>\n<ol>\n<li>使用 <strong>tdd-guide<\/strong> 代理<\/li>\n<li>检查测试隔离<\/li>\n<li>验证模拟是否正确<\/li>\n<li>修复实现，而非测试（除非测试有误）<\/li>\n<\/ol>\n<h2>代理支持<\/h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>tdd-guide<\/strong> - 主动用于新功能，强制先写测试<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n"
